summary.zh: 日本关东军炸毁南满铁路柳条湖段并进攻沈阳北大营，中国抗日战争由此开始。
summary.en: The Japanese Kwantung Army blew up the South Manchuria Railway near Liutiaohu and attacked Beidaying in Shenyang, beginning China’s war of resistance.

description.zh:
1931 年 9 月 18 日夜，日本关东军自行炸毁沈阳北郊柳条湖附近的南满铁路路轨，反诬中国军队所为，随即进攻东北军北大营和沈阳城。此后数月，日军侵占东北大部。

本事件日期与地点为通行说法，具体战斗经过待史料校订。
description.en:
On the night of 18 September 1931, the Japanese Kwantung Army destroyed a section of the South Manchuria Railway near Liutiaohu, blamed Chinese troops, and attacked Beidaying and Shenyang. Within months Japanese forces occupied most of the Northeast.

Dates and locations follow conventional accounts; details await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

name.zh: 中国向国联申诉九一八事变
name.en: China’s Appeal to the League of Nations

summary.zh: 中国代表施肇基援引《国联盟约》第十一条向国联申诉，要求制止日军进攻、恢复事变前状态。
summary.en: Chinese representative Sao-Ke Alfred Sze appealed to the League of Nations under Article 11 of the Covenant, asking it to stop the Japanese advance and restore the status quo ante.

description.zh:
1931 年 9 月 21 日，中国驻国联代表施肇基向国联秘书长递交声明书，援引《国联盟约》第十一条，控告日本侵略中国领土，要求国联行政院立即采取行动，阻止事态扩大、恢复九一八事变前的状态，并确定中国应得的赔偿。

国民政府把制止日本侵略的希望主要寄托于国联调处，但国联行政院仅向中日双方发出内容相同的“紧急警告”，未将日本定为侵略者，也未采取制裁。此后国联决定派遣调查团，即李顿调查团。

外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 21 September 1931 Chinese representative Sao-Ke Alfred Sze submitted a note to the League of Nations Secretary-General invoking Article 11 of the Covenant, accusing Japan of invading Chinese territory and asking the Council to stop the widening of the incident, restore the status quo ante, and determine reparations.

The Nationalist government placed its main hope in League mediation, but the Council only issued identical urgent warnings to both sides, neither naming Japan the aggressor nor imposing sanctions. The League subsequently decided to send a commission of inquiry — the Lytton Commission.

A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所
sources.note: 国联申诉经过参考，待页码核对

summary.zh: 日军西进占领锦州，东北军退入关内，辽西沦陷。
summary.en: Japanese forces advanced west and took Jinzhou; the Northeast Army withdrew inside the Great Wall, leaving western Liaoning occupied.

description.zh:
九一八事变后，日军沿南满铁路向北推进，同时西进辽西。1932 年 1 月 3 日占领锦州，东北军在张学良命令下未作有力抵抗即退入关内，辽西与热河门户洞开。

日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
After the Mukden Incident, Japanese forces pushed north along the South Manchuria Railway and west into western Liaoning. They occupied Jinzhou on 3 January 1932; the Northeast Army, under Zhang Xueliang’s orders, withdrew inside the Great Wall without effective resistance, leaving western Liaoning and the approaches to Rehe open.

Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 日军进攻上海闸北，第十九路军等部奋起抵抗，淞沪地区爆发激烈战斗。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Zhabei in Shanghai; the 19th Route Army and other Chinese units resisted in fierce fighting.

description.zh:
1932 年 1 月 28 日，日军以保护侨民为借口进攻上海闸北。第十九路军在蒋光鼐、蔡廷锴指挥下抵抗，双方在淞沪地区激战至 3 月。5 月，中日签订《淞沪停战协定》。

本事件日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 28 January 1932, Japanese forces attacked Zhabei in Shanghai under the pretext of protecting residents. The 19th Route Army, commanded by Jiang Guangnai and Cai Tingkai, resisted until March. In May, China and Japan signed the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement.

Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 日军占领哈尔滨，东北主要城市至此基本沦陷。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Harbin, completing the occupation of the Northeast’s major cities.

description.zh:
1932 年 2 月 5 日，日军进入哈尔滨。此前齐齐哈尔、锦州等地已相继失守，东北三省主要城市至此基本被日军控制。

本事件为路线分段端点，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
Japanese troops entered Harbin on 5 February 1932. Qiqihar, Jinzhou, and other cities had already fallen, leaving the major cities of the three northeastern provinces largely under Japanese control.

This event marks a route segment endpoint; the date follows conventional accounts and awaits historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

place.en: Changchun, Jilin (called “Xinjing” by the puppet state)

summary.zh: 日本扶植溥仪在长春成立伪满洲国，东北被纳入日本殖民统治体系。
summary.en: Japan installed Puyi as head of the puppet state of Manchukuo in Changchun, placing the Northeast under colonial rule.

description.zh:
1932 年 3 月 1 日，日本扶植清朝末代皇帝溥仪在长春成立伪满洲国，随后以“日满议定书”等形式加以控制。中国政府与国际联盟均未承认该政权。

本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
On 1 March 1932, Japan installed Puyi, the last Qing emperor, as head of the puppet state of Manchukuo in Changchun, later controlling it through agreements such as the Japan-Manchukuo Protocol. Neither the Chinese government nor the League of Nations recognized the regime.

This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

sources.title: 《剑桥中华民国史》
sources.author: 费正清、费维恺编
sources.note: 伪满政权建立背景参考

name.zh: 国联李顿调查团赴东北

summary.zh: 国际联盟调查团抵达沈阳调查九一八事变；报告否认伪满洲国合法性，但未认定日本为侵略者。
summary.en: The League of Nations commission reached Shenyang to investigate the Mukden Incident; its report denied Manchukuo’s legitimacy but did not name Japan an aggressor.

description.zh:
1932 年 4 月 21 日，国际联盟李顿调查团抵达沈阳，开始调查九一八事变后的东北局势。调查团由英、美、法、德、意五国代表组成，英国代表李顿任团长；中国代表顾维钧以顾问（襄助委员）身份参加。

调查团不是中国政府派出的：1931 年 9 月 21 日中国政府向国联申诉，同年 12 月 10 日国联行政院决议派遣调查团。中国政府是申诉方和当事国，负责接待与配合，但调查的发起、组成和结论都出自国联。

调查团 10 月 2 日公布报告书，承认东北是中国领土、否认伪满洲国的合法性，但未将日本定为侵略者，主张国际共管。1933 年 2 月国联大会通过报告书，日本随后退出国联。

国际事件，不绘制路线；日期、职务与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 21 April 1932 the League of Nations Lytton Commission reached Shenyang and began investigating the situation in the Northeast after the Mukden Incident. The commission consisted of representatives of Britain, the United States, France, Germany, and Italy, with the British representative Lord Lytton as chairman; the Chinese representative Wellington Koo took part as assessor.

The commission was not sent by the Chinese government: China appealed to the League on 21 September 1931, and the League Council resolved on 10 December 1931 to send a commission of inquiry. China was the complainant and the party concerned and handled reception and cooperation, but the initiative, composition, and conclusions belonged to the League.

The report, published on 2 October 1932, recognized the Northeast as Chinese territory and denied the legality of Manchukuo, but did not name Japan as an aggressor and proposed international administration. The League Assembly adopted the report in February 1933, and Japan withdrew from the League soon afterwards.

An international event with no route drawn; dates, titles, and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《剑桥中华民国史》
sources.author: 费正清、费维恺编
sources.note: 国联调处与李顿报告参考

name.en: Signing of the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement

summary.zh: 中日签订《淞沪停战协定》，一·二八事变结束，中国军队退出上海市区。
summary.en: China and Japan signed the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement, ending the January 28 Incident and requiring Chinese troops to withdraw from urban Shanghai.

description.zh:
1932 年 5 月 5 日，中日双方签订《淞沪停战协定》，规定上海为非武装区，中国军队不得驻守市区，日军则可留驻部分区域。一·二八事变至此结束，但协定被舆论视为屈辱让步。

外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 5 May 1932 China and Japan signed the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement, making Shanghai a demilitarized zone: Chinese troops were barred from the urban area while Japanese forces could remain in parts of it. The January 28 Incident thus ended, though the agreement was widely seen as a humiliating concession.

A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 一·二八事变后，第十九路军由上海调驻福建。
summary.en: After the January 28 Incident the 19th Route Army moved from Shanghai to Fujian.

description.zh:
1932 年 5 月《淞沪停战协定》签订后，第十九路军由上海调驻福建。1933 年 11 月，该部在福州发动福建事变，另立政府，次年失败。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
After the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement of May 1932, the 19th Route Army moved from Shanghai to Fujian. In November 1933 it launched the Fujian Incident at Fuzhou and formed a separate government, which collapsed the following year.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

place.zh: 河北山海关（今属秦皇岛）

summary.zh: 日军进攻山海关，东北军何柱国部抵抗，榆关三日失守，长城抗战序幕拉开。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Shanhaiguan; He Zhuguo’s Northeast Army troops resisted for three days before the pass fell, opening the Great Wall campaign.

description.zh:
1933 年 1 月 1 日，日军以炮火进攻山海关，东北军第九旅何柱国部奋起抵抗。守军兵力单薄、后援不继，1 月 3 日榆关失守。此役是九一八事变后中国军队在华北的首次有组织抵抗，也被视为长城抗战的序幕。

日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 1 January 1933 Japanese artillery opened the attack on Shanhaiguan, and He Zhuguo’s 9th Brigade of the Northeast Army resisted. With insufficient troops and no reinforcements, the pass fell on 3 January. It was the first organized Chinese resistance in North China after the Mukden Incident and is regarded as the opening of the Great Wall campaign.

Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 日军分路进攻热河，中国守军节节败退，承德于三月失守。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Rehe along several axes; Chinese defenders fell back and Chengde was lost in March.

description.zh:
1933 年 2 月 21 日，关东军与伪军分路向热河进攻，中国守军指挥不一、士气低落，防线迅速崩溃。3 月 4 日日军占领承德，热河全省沦陷，东北全部落入日本控制，日军兵锋直指长城各口。

日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 21 February 1933 the Kwantung Army and puppet troops attacked Rehe along several axes. Chinese defenders, poorly coordinated and demoralized, collapsed quickly. Chengde fell on 4 March, the whole province was occupied, and the Japanese advance reached the Great Wall passes.

Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

name.zh: 国联大会通过李顿报告书
name.en: The League Assembly Adopts the Lytton Report

summary.zh: 国联大会通过李顿报告书，承认中国对东北的主权、不承认伪满洲国；日本随后退出国联。
summary.en: The League Assembly adopted the Lytton Report, recognizing Chinese sovereignty over the Northeast and denying Manchukuo; Japan then withdrew from the League.

description.zh:
1933 年 2 月 24 日，国际联盟大会以压倒多数通过李顿报告书，承认东北是中国领土、不承认伪满洲国的合法性，要求日军撤出。日本投下唯一反对票，代表当场退场，并于 3 月 27 日正式退出国联；随后日军进攻热河，扩大侵华战争。

决议出自国联大会，中国政府是申诉方和受益方，但不是决议的制定者；国联也没有能力强制日本执行。

国际事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 24 February 1933 the League of Nations Assembly adopted the Lytton Report by an overwhelming majority, recognizing Chinese sovereignty over the Northeast, denying the legality of Manchukuo, and calling for the withdrawal of Japanese troops. Japan cast the sole opposing vote; its delegate left the hall, and Japan formally withdrew from the League on 27 March. Japanese forces then attacked Rehe (Jehol), widening the war.

The resolution came from the League Assembly; the Chinese government was the complainant and beneficiary, not the author, and the League had no means to enforce it.

An international event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所
sources.note: 国联决议经过参考，待页码核对

sources.title: 《剑桥中华民国史》
sources.author: 费正清、费维恺编
sources.note: 国联调处与李顿报告参考

summary.zh: 日军占领承德，热河全省沦陷，东北四省全部被日本控制。
summary.en: Japanese forces occupied Chengde and the whole of Rehe, completing the occupation of the four northeastern provinces.

description.zh:
1933 年 3 月 4 日，日军先头部队进入承德，热河省主席汤玉麟此前已弃城逃走。热河沦陷后，东北四省全部被日本控制，日军与中国军队在长城一线形成对峙。

日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 4 March 1933 Japanese advance units entered Chengde after provincial chairman Tang Yulin had fled. With Rehe lost, all four northeastern provinces were under Japanese control, and Japanese and Chinese forces faced each other along the Great Wall.

Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 第29军、第17军、第32军及东北军等部在喜峰口、罗文峪、古北口、冷口等关口抗击日军，最终以《塘沽协定》收场。
summary.en: The 29th, 17th, and 32nd Armies and Northeast Army units fought the Japanese at Xifengkou, Luowenyu, Gubeikou, and Lengkou until the Tanggu Truce ended the campaign.

description.zh:
1933 年 3 月至 5 月，中国军队依托长城各口抗击日军。主要参战部队：

- 喜峰口、罗文峪：第29军（宋哲元），辖第37师（冯治安）、第38师（张自忠）、暂编第2师（刘汝明）；
- 古北口、南天门：东北军第67军（王以哲）先守，中央军第17军（徐庭瑶）第2师（黄杰）、第25师（关麟征）、第83师（刘戡）增援；
- 冷口：第32军（商震）第139师等部；
- 界岭口：东北军第53军（万福麟）等部。

由于装备与指挥劣势，中国军队最终后撤，5 月 31 日签订《塘沽协定》。

日期与部队番号取通行说法，待史料校订。

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 第29军宋哲元部在喜峰口以大刀夜袭日军，取得长城抗战中著名胜利。
summary.en: Song Zheyuan’s 29th Army raided Japanese camps at Xifengkou with broadswords, winning one of the best-known victories of the Great Wall campaign.

description.zh:
1933 年 3 月 9 日，日军进攻喜峰口，第29军（军长宋哲元）第37师（冯治安）、第38师（张自忠）驰援。11 日夜，第37师第109旅旅长赵登禹、佟泽光等率部攀山绕袭日军营地，以大刀近战重创敌军。喜峰口战斗打破了日军不可战胜的形象，也让第29军声名大振。

日期与部队番号取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 9 March 1933 Japanese forces attacked Xifengkou, and the 29th Army under Song Zheyuan rushed its 37th Division (Feng Zhi’an) and 38th Division (Zhang Zizhong) to defend it. On the night of 11 March, Zhao Dengyu, commander of the 37th Division’s 109th Brigade, and Tong Zeguang led troops over the mountains to raid Japanese camps, inflicting heavy losses in close combat with broadswords. The battle shattered the image of Japanese invincibility and made the 29th Army famous.

Dates and unit designations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 第32军商震部在冷口抗击日军，反复争夺后于 4 月失守。
summary.en: Shang Zhen’s 32nd Army fought the Japanese at Lengkou and lost the pass in April after repeated see-saw battles.

description.zh:
1933 年 3 月，日军进攻冷口，第32军（军长商震）第139师等部依托关隘抗击，双方反复争夺。4 月中旬冷口失守，中国军队退守滦河以西。冷口与喜峰口、古北口同为长城抗战的主要方向。

日期与部队番号取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In March 1933 Japanese forces attacked Lengkou, where the 32nd Army under Shang Zhen, including the 139th Division, held the pass in repeated see-saw fighting. Lengkou fell in mid-April and the Chinese forces withdrew west of the Luan River. Lengkou was one of the main sectors of the Great Wall campaign alongside Xifengkou and Gubeikou.

Dates and unit designations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 东北军第67军与中央军第17军在古北口、南天门一线抗击日军，伤亡惨重。
summary.en: The Northeast Army’s 67th Corps and the Central Army’s 17th Army fought the Japanese at Gubeikou and Nantianmen at heavy cost.

description.zh:
1933 年 3 月 10 日，日军进攻古北口，东北军第67军（王以哲）先守，中央军第17军（徐庭瑶）第25师（关麟征）、第2师（黄杰）、第83师（刘戡）等部陆续增援。双方在南天门一线反复争夺至 4 月下旬，中国军队伤亡惨重但仍迟滞了日军推进。古北口是长城抗战中战斗最激烈的方向之一。

日期与部队番号取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 10 March 1933 Japanese forces attacked Gubeikou. The Northeast Army’s 67th Corps under Wang Yizhe held first, then the Central Army’s 17th Army under Xu Tingyao reinforced with the 25th Division (Guan Linzheng), 2nd Division (Huang Jie), and 83rd Division (Liu Kan). Fighting around Nantianmen continued into late April; Chinese casualties were heavy, but the defense delayed the Japanese advance. Gubeikou was one of the most bitterly contested sectors of the Great Wall campaign.

Dates and unit designations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 第29军暂编第2师在罗文峪抗击日军，与喜峰口互为犄角。
summary.en: The 29th Army’s Provisional 2nd Division fought the Japanese at Luowenyu, supporting the Xifengkou defense.

description.zh:
1933 年 3 月 16 日至 18 日，日军进攻罗文峪，第29军暂编第2师（刘汝明）依托关隘抗击，与喜峰口方向互为犄角。罗文峪战斗是长城抗战中第29军的另一处重要阵地。

日期与部队番号取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
From 16 to 18 March 1933 Japanese forces attacked Luowenyu, where the 29th Army’s Provisional 2nd Division under Liu Ruming held the pass and supported the Xifengkou sector. Luowenyu was another important position for the 29th Army in the Great Wall campaign.

Dates and unit designations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.zh: 察哈尔民众抗日同盟军成立
name.en: Establishment of the Chahar People’s Anti-Japanese Allied Army

summary.zh: 冯玉祥（下野的西北军领袖）、吉鸿昌（原第22路军总指挥，中共秘密党员）、方振武等在张家口成立抗日同盟军，冯玉祥任总司令。
summary.en: Feng Yuxiang (retired Northwest Army leader), Ji Hongchang (former 22nd Route Army commander and secret CCP member), and Fang Zhenwu formed the Anti-Japanese Allied Army at Zhangjiakou, with Feng as commander-in-chief.

description.zh:
1933 年 5 月 26 日，冯玉祥、吉鸿昌、方振武等在张家口成立察哈尔民众抗日同盟军，号召武装抗日、收复失地。

三人当时的身份并不相同：

- **冯玉祥**：中原大战后下野的西北军领袖。1928 年曾任国民政府行政院副院长兼军政部长，1930 年反蒋失败后失去实权；1933 年无军政实职，被推举为同盟军总司令。
- **吉鸿昌**：冯玉祥旧部、原西北军将领，曾任第22路军总指挥兼第30军军长。1931 年因不愿「剿共」被解除兵权、被迫出洋考察，1932 年回国并加入中国共产党；在同盟军任前敌总指挥兼第2军军长。
- **方振武**：原国民军将领，曾任安徽省政府主席，反蒋被囚后于 1931 年获释；1933 年变卖财产组织抗日救国军北上，任同盟军北路前敌总司令。

同盟军在中共北方党组织推动与协助下组建，队伍一度发展到十万余人，北上收复康保、宝昌、沽源和多伦，但在日军与国民党当局的双重压力下于同年秋解散。

建制事件，不单独绘制路线；日期、职务与人数取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 26 May 1933 Feng Yuxiang, Ji Hongchang, Fang Zhenwu, and others formed the Chahar People’s Anti-Japanese Allied Army at Zhangjiakou, calling for armed resistance and the recovery of lost territory.

Their standing at the time differed:

- **Feng Yuxiang** was the retired leader of the Northwest Army. He had served as vice president of the Executive Yuan and minister of military administration in 1928, but lost real power after his anti-Chiang coalition was defeated in 1930. Holding no military or government office in 1933, he was elected commander-in-chief of the Allied Army.
- **Ji Hongchang**, a former Northwest Army general under Feng, had commanded the 22nd Route Army and the 30th Army. Relieved of command in 1931 for refusing to fight the Communists and sent abroad, he returned to China in 1932 and joined the Chinese Communist Party. In the Allied Army he served as front-line commander-in-chief and commander of the 2nd Army.
- **Fang Zhenwu**, a former National Army general and governor of Anhui, had been imprisoned for opposing Chiang and released in 1931. In 1933 he sold his property to raise the Anti-Japanese National Salvation Army and became the Allied Army’s northern front commander.

Organized with the encouragement and help of the CCP’s northern organization, the army grew to more than 100,000 men and recovered Kangbao, Baochang, Guyuan, and Duolun before being disbanded that autumn under pressure from both Japan and the Nationalist government.

An organizational event with no separate route; dates, titles, and troop numbers follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 中日签订《塘沽协定》，中国默认日军对东北、热河的控制，冀东被划为非武装区。
summary.en: China and Japan signed the Tanggu Truce, tacitly accepting Japanese control of the Northeast and Rehe and creating a demilitarized zone in eastern Hebei.

description.zh:
1933 年 5 月 31 日，中国代表熊斌与日本代表冈村宁次在塘沽签订停战协定。协定规定中国军队撤至延庆、昌平、高丽营、顺义、通州、香河、宝坻、林亭口、宁河、芦台一线以西以南，冀东划为非武装区。中国实际上默认了日本对东北和热河的控制。

外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 31 May 1933 Chinese representative Xiong Bin and Japanese representative Okamura Yasuji signed a truce at Tanggu. Chinese troops were to withdraw west and south of a line through Yanqing, Changping, Gaoliying, Shunyi, Tongzhou, Xianghe, Baodi, Lintingkou, Ninghe, and Lutai, and eastern Hebei became a demilitarized zone. China thus tacitly accepted Japanese control of the Northeast and Rehe.

A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

place.zh: 察哈尔多伦（今属内蒙古）

summary.zh: 察哈尔抗日同盟军北路前敌总司令方振武、总指挥吉鸿昌率部收复多伦，为九一八事变后中国军队首次收复失地。
summary.en: The northern front of the Chahar Anti-Japanese Allied Army, under Fang Zhenwu and Ji Hongchang, retook Duolun — the first recovery of lost territory by Chinese forces after the Mukden Incident.

description.zh:
1933 年 7 月，察哈尔民众抗日同盟军北路前敌总司令方振武、总指挥吉鸿昌率部围攻多伦，经数日激战于 7 月 12 日收复该城。这是九一八事变后中国军队首次从日军及其伪军手中收复失地，在舆论上引起很大反响。

吉鸿昌当时是原西北军将领、第22路军前总指挥，1932 年加入中国共产党，在同盟军任前敌总指挥兼第2军军长。

日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In July 1933 the northern front of the Chahar People’s Anti-Japanese Allied Army, commanded by Fang Zhenwu and Ji Hongchang, besieged Duolun and retook the town on 12 July after several days of fighting. It was the first recovery of lost territory from Japanese and puppet forces after the Mukden Incident and caused a sensation in public opinion.

Ji Hongchang was a former Northwest Army general and former commander of the 22nd Route Army; he joined the Chinese Communist Party in 1932 and served as the Allied Army’s front-line commander-in-chief and commander of the 2nd Army.

Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 第十九路军在福州另立政府，次年失败。
summary.en: The 19th Route Army set up a separate government at Fuzhou, which collapsed the following year.

description.zh:
1933 年 11 月 20 日，第十九路军将领蒋光鼐、蔡廷锴等在福州发动福建事变，成立“中华共和国人民革命政府”，不久在南京政府军事压力下失败。

政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
On 20 November 1933 Jiang Guangnai, Cai Tingkai, and other 19th Route Army commanders launched the Fujian Incident at Fuzhou and established the “People’s Revolutionary Government of the Chinese Republic,” which soon collapsed under military pressure from Nanjing.

A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.zh: 蒋介石在南昌发起新生活运动，以“礼义廉耻”整饬社会风气。
summary.en: Chiang Kai-shek launched the New Life Movement in Nanchang, promoting “propriety, righteousness, honesty, and shame” to reform social habits.

description.zh:
1934 年 2 月，蒋介石在南昌发起新生活运动，提倡“礼义廉耻”，要求生活军事化、生产化、艺术化，试图以道德教化整饬社会。运动持续到抗战时期，实际效果有限。

日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In February 1934 Chiang Kai-shek launched the New Life Movement in Nanchang, promoting “propriety, righteousness, honesty, and shame” and calling for a militarized, productive, and artistic daily life. The movement continued into the war years with limited practical effect.

Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所
sources.note: 事件经过参考，待页码核对

name.en: Puyi Enthroned as Emperor of Manchukuo

summary.zh: 溥仪在长春称“满洲帝国皇帝”，伪满政权进一步制度化。
summary.en: Puyi was enthroned as “Emperor of Manchukuo” in Changchun, further institutionalizing the puppet regime.

description.zh:
1934 年 3 月 1 日，溥仪在长春称“满洲帝国皇帝”，改元“康德”。伪满政权在日本关东军控制下进一步完善殖民统治机构，但始终未获中国政府与国际社会普遍承认。

政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 1 March 1934 Puyi was enthroned as “Emperor of Manchukuo” in Changchun and adopted the era name Kangde. Under Kwantung Army control the puppet state further developed its colonial institutions, but it was never widely recognized by the Chinese government or the international community.

A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 日本外务省发表天羽声明，反对列强援助中国，暴露独占中国的意图。
summary.en: Japan’s Foreign Ministry issued the Amau Statement, opposing foreign aid to China and revealing its aim of monopolizing China.

description.zh:
1934 年 4 月 17 日，日本外务省情报部长天羽英二发表非正式声明，称日本对东亚有特殊责任，反对列强向中国提供武器、借款或技术援助。声明被中国与英美等国视为“亚洲门罗主义”，加剧了华北危机前的紧张局势。

外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 17 April 1934 Amau Eiji, spokesman of Japan’s Foreign Ministry, issued an informal statement claiming a special Japanese responsibility in East Asia and opposing foreign arms, loans, or technical aid to China. China, Britain, and the United States saw it as an “Asian Monroe Doctrine,” heightening tensions before the North China crisis.

A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.zh: 日本驻南京副领事藏本英明失踪，日方借机陈兵施压，数日后其被发现在紫金山隐居。
summary.en: A Japanese vice-consul in Nanjing disappeared; Japan massed warships as a pretext, but he was found days later hiding in the Zijin Mountains.

description.zh:
1934 年 6 月 9 日，日本驻南京总领事馆副领事藏本英明失踪。日本方面宣称其被中国方面绑架，调集军舰施压。6 月 13 日，藏本在南京紫金山被发现，自称因精神苦闷出走，日方的借口随之破产。

外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 9 June 1934 Kuramoto, a vice-consul at the Japanese consulate in Nanjing, disappeared. Japan claimed he had been kidnapped by the Chinese side and massed warships as pressure. On 13 June he was found in the Zijin Mountains outside Nanjing, saying he had left because of mental distress, and the Japanese pretext collapsed.

A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 日军在察哈尔东部沽源一带挑起冲突，进攻长梁、乌泥河等地。
summary.en: Japanese forces provoked clashes around Guyuan in eastern Chahar, attacking Changliang, Wunihe, and other places.

description.zh:
1935 年 1 月，日军在察哈尔东部沽源一带挑起冲突，进攻长梁、乌泥河等地，中国守军与地方武装抵抗。事件后中日双方在大滩交涉，2 月达成口约。

军事事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In January 1935 Japanese forces provoked clashes around Guyuan in eastern Chahar, attacking Changliang, Wunihe, and other places, where Chinese garrisons and local forces resisted. Negotiations followed at Datan and produced an oral accord in February.

A military event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 中方与日方在大滩达成口约，中国军队撤出察东，日军获得自由行动空间。
summary.en: China and Japan reached an oral accord at Datan: Chinese troops withdrew from eastern Chahar and Japanese forces gained freedom of movement.

description.zh:
1935 年 2 月 2 日，中方与日方在察哈尔沽源大滩达成口约，中国军队撤出察东，日军获得自由行动空间。这是中日双方共同的行为，但中国处于被迫接受的一方，为同年张北事件与秦土协定埋下伏笔。

外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 2 February 1935 China and Japan reached an oral accord at Datan in Guyuan, Chahar: Chinese troops withdrew from eastern Chahar and Japanese forces gained freedom of movement. It was a bilateral act, but China was forced to accept, and it set the stage for the Zhangbei Incident and the Qin-Doihara Agreement later that year.

A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 蒋介石在贵阳发起国民经济建设运动，推动交通、工矿与农村建设。
summary.en: Chiang Kai-shek launched the National Economic Construction Movement in Guiyang to promote transport, industry, mining, and rural construction.

description.zh:
1935 年 4 月，蒋介石在贵阳发起国民经济建设运动，号召“尽人力、辟地利、均供求、畅流通”，推动交通、工矿、农村合作与国防经济建设。该运动与法币改革同为战前经济准备的一部分。

日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In April 1935 Chiang Kai-shek launched the National Economic Construction Movement in Guiyang, calling for mobilizing labor, developing resources, balancing supply and demand, and improving distribution. It promoted transport, industry, mining, rural cooperatives, and defense-related construction, alongside the currency reform as part of prewar economic preparation.

Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所
sources.note: 事件经过参考，待页码核对

summary.zh: 日本特务在张北被中国守军盘查，日方借机提出交涉。
summary.en: Japanese agents were stopped and questioned by Chinese guards at Zhangbei, and Japan used the incident to demand concessions.

description.zh:
1935 年 6 月 5 日，日本特务在张北被中国守军盘查，日方借机提出交涉，要求撤换有关人员、撤退察哈尔省境内国民党军与党部，并取缔抗日活动。6 月 27 日秦德纯与土肥原贤二签订“秦土协定”。

外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 5 June 1935 Japanese agents were stopped and questioned by Chinese guards at Zhangbei. Japan used the incident to demand the replacement of the officers involved, the withdrawal of Nationalist troops and party offices from Chahar, and the suppression of anti-Japanese activities. On 27 June Qin Dechun and Doihara Kenji signed the Qin-Doihara Agreement.

A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 日军以孙永勤部进入滦东“非武装区”和胡白被杀为借口，向北平军分会提出交涉并调兵施压。
summary.en: Japan used Sun Yongqin’s entry into the demilitarized zone east of the Luan River and the killing of Hu Bai as pretexts to press the Beiping Military Council and move troops.

description.zh:
1935 年 5 至 6 月，日军以孙永勤部进入滦东“非武装区”和胡白被杀事件为借口，向北平军分会代委员长何应钦提出交涉，并从东北调兵入关施压。日方要求撤换河北省军政人员、撤出中央军与国民党党部。7 月 6 日何应钦复函接受，形成“何梅协定”。

外交/军事事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In May and June 1935 Japan used Sun Yongqin’s entry into the demilitarized zone east of the Luan River and the killing of Hu Bai as pretexts to press He Yingqin, acting chairman of the Beiping Military Council, and moved troops from the Northeast through the Great Wall. Japan demanded the replacement of Hebei officials and the withdrawal of Central Army units and Nationalist Party offices. He Yingqin’s reply of 6 July accepted these demands, producing the He-Umezu Agreement.

A diplomatic and military event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 秦德纯与土肥原贤二签订协定，中国同意撤军、撤换人员并取缔抗日活动。
summary.en: Qin Dechun and Doihara Kenji signed an agreement under which China withdrew troops and officials and suppressed anti-Japanese activities in Chahar.

description.zh:
1935 年 6 月 27 日，秦德纯与土肥原贤二在北平签订协定，中国方面同意撤换有关人员、撤退察哈尔省境内国民党军与党部，并取缔抗日活动。察哈尔主权进一步受损。

外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 27 June 1935 Qin Dechun and Doihara Kenji signed an agreement in Beiping: China replaced the officials involved, withdrew Nationalist troops and party offices from Chahar, and suppressed anti-Japanese activities. Chahar’s sovereignty was further eroded.

A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 何应钦复函梅津美治郎，接受日方要求，中央军与国民党党部退出河北。
summary.en: He Yingqin replied to Umezu Yoshijiro, accepting Japanese demands and withdrawing Central Army units and party offices from Hebei.

description.zh:
1935 年 7 月 6 日，北平军分会代委员长何应钦复函日本华北驻屯军司令梅津美治郎，实质上接受日方要求：中央军与国民党党部退出河北，撤换有关军政人员。此即“何梅协定”，中国在华北的主权进一步受损。

外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 6 July 1935 He Yingqin, acting chairman of the Beiping Military Council, replied to Umezu Yoshijiro, commander of the Japanese garrison in North China, effectively accepting Japanese demands: Central Army units and Nationalist Party offices withdrew from Hebei and officials were replaced. This is known as the He-Umezu Agreement, which further eroded Chinese sovereignty in North China.

A diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 国民政府实行法币政策，统一货币、稳定金融，为抗战经济动员奠定基础。
summary.en: The Nationalist government introduced the fabi currency, unifying the monetary system and stabilizing finance for wartime mobilization.

description.zh:
1935 年 11 月 3 日，国民政府财政部宣布法币政策，白银收归国有，以中央、中国、交通等银行发行的钞票为法币，统一货币、稳定金融。法币改革为抗战时期的财政与军费动员提供了基础。

日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 3 November 1935 the Ministry of Finance announced the fabi reform: silver was nationalized and notes issued by the Central Bank of China, Bank of China, Bank of Communications, and others became legal tender. The reform unified the currency and stabilized finance, providing a basis for wartime fiscal and military mobilization.

Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所
sources.note: 事件经过参考，待页码核对

name.zh: 冀东防共自治委员会成立

summary.zh: 殷汝耕在通州成立冀东防共自治委员会，冀东二十二县脱离南京管辖。
summary.en: Yin Rugeng set up the East Hebei Anti-Communist Autonomous Council at Tongzhou, detaching 22 counties from Nanjing’s authority.

description.zh:
1935 年 11 月 25 日，殷汝耕在通州成立“冀东防共自治委员会”，宣布冀东二十二县“自治”，实际处于日本控制之下。此举是华北自治运动的高潮，直接引发一二·九运动。

政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 25 November 1935 Yin Rugeng established the “East Hebei Anti-Communist Autonomous Council” at Tongzhou, declaring 22 counties of eastern Hebei “autonomous” under de facto Japanese control. It marked the peak of the North China autonomy movement and directly triggered the December Ninth Movement.

A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 北平学生举行抗日救亡请愿游行，推动全国抗日救亡运动高涨。
summary.en: Students in Beiping marched to demand resistance and national salvation, helping to galvanize anti-Japanese sentiment nationwide.

description.zh:
1935 年 12 月 9 日，北平学生数千人举行抗日救亡请愿游行，反对华北自治，要求停止内战、一致对外。运动迅速扩展到全国，成为抗日民族统一战线形成的重要背景。

本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
On 9 December 1935, thousands of students in Beiping demonstrated against the autonomy movement in North China and called for an end to civil war and united resistance. The movement spread nationwide and became an important backdrop to the formation of the anti-Japanese united front.

This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.zh: 北平学生举行更大规模游行，抗议冀察政务委员会成立，运动扩展至全国。
summary.en: Students in Beiping held an even larger demonstration against the Hebei-Chahar Political Council, and the movement spread nationwide.

description.zh:
1935 年 12 月 16 日，北平学生万余人举行游行，抗议冀察政务委员会成立，遭到军警镇压。运动迅速扩展到天津、上海、南京、广州等地，成为全国抗日救亡运动的新高潮，也为抗日民族统一战线的形成准备了群众基础。

政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 16 December 1935 more than ten thousand students marched in Beiping against the Hebei-Chahar Political Council and were suppressed by police. The movement quickly spread to Tianjin, Shanghai, Nanjing, Guangzhou, and elsewhere, becoming a new high point of national salvation activity and preparing popular ground for the anti-Japanese united front.

A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

name.zh: 华北自治运动与冀察政务委员会成立
name.en: North China Autonomy Movement and the Hebei-Chahar Political Council

summary.zh: 日本策动华北五省“自治”，南京国民政府被迫设立半独立性质的冀察政务委员会。
summary.en: Japan promoted “autonomy” in five North China provinces, forcing Nanjing to create the semi-autonomous Hebei-Chahar Political Council.

description.zh:
1935 年秋，日本策动华北五省“自治运动”，扶植殷汝耕在通州成立“冀东防共自治委员会”。南京国民政府在日本压力下于 12 月 18 日设立冀察政务委员会，由宋哲元任委员长，华北出现半独立局面。此举直接引发了一二·九与一二·一六运动。

政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In autumn 1935 Japan promoted an “autonomy movement” across five North China provinces and sponsored Yin Rugeng’s “East Hebei Anti-Communist Autonomous Council” at Tongzhou. Under Japanese pressure Nanjing established the Hebei-Chahar Political Council on 18 December, chaired by Song Zheyuan, leaving North China semi-autonomous. The move directly triggered the December Ninth and December Sixteenth movements.

A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 陈济棠、李宗仁等以“北上抗日”为号召反蒋，事变后和平解决。
summary.en: Chen Jitang and Li Zongren moved against Chiang Kai-shek under the banner of “marching north to resist Japan”; the incident was resolved peacefully.

description.zh:
1936 年 6 月，广东陈济棠与广西李宗仁、白崇禧联合反蒋，组织“抗日救国军”北上，史称两广事变。蒋介石分化瓦解，陈济棠部将余汉谋倒戈，7 月陈济棠下野，事变和平解决，两广重归南京国民政府统辖。

政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In June 1936 Chen Jitang of Guangdong joined Li Zongren and Bai Chongxi of Guangxi against Chiang Kai-shek, forming a “Anti-Japanese National Salvation Army” and marching north; the episode is known as the Liangguang Incident. Chiang undermined the coalition, Chen’s subordinate Yu Hanmou defected, and Chen stepped down in July. The incident ended peacefully and the two provinces returned to Nanjing’s authority.

A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

name.zh: 日军策动伪蒙军进攻绥远

summary.zh: 日本关东军策动伪蒙军自商都进攻绥远，傅作义部奋起抵抗。
summary.en: The Kwantung Army directed Mengjiang forces from Shangdu against Suiyuan, where Fu Zuoyi’s troops resisted.

description.zh:
1936 年 11 月，日本关东军策动德王所属伪蒙军自商都一带西进，进攻绥远东部。绥远省主席傅作义率晋绥军迎战，先后取得红格尔图与百灵庙战斗的胜利。绥远抗战得到全国各界慰问与支援，成为西安事变前抗日情绪高涨的重要背景。

日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In November 1936 the Kwantung Army directed Prince De’s Mengjiang forces westward from the Shangdu area against eastern Suiyuan. Suiyuan chairman Fu Zuoyi led Shanxi-Suiyuan troops to meet them and won the battles of Honggeertu and Bailingmiao. The Suiyuan campaign drew nationwide support and helped raise anti-Japanese sentiment before the Xi’an Incident.

Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 傅作义部在红格尔图击退伪蒙军进攻，绥远抗战由此展开。
summary.en: Fu Zuoyi’s forces repelled the Mengjiang attack at Honggeertu, opening the Suiyuan campaign.

description.zh:
1936 年 11 月 15 日，伪蒙军在日本顾问指挥下进攻红格尔图。傅作义部骑兵与守军协同反击，经数日激战将其击退，毙伤俘敌数百人。红格尔图战斗是绥远抗战的首场胜利，为随后收复百灵庙创造了条件。

日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 15 November 1936 Mengjiang troops under Japanese advisers attacked Honggeertu. Fu Zuoyi’s cavalry and garrison counterattacked and, after several days of fighting, drove them back with hundreds of casualties and prisoners. The victory at Honggeertu opened the Suiyuan campaign and paved the way for the recovery of Bailingmiao.

Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 傅作义部奇袭百灵庙，取得绥远抗战决定性胜利，全国慰问运动高涨。
summary.en: Fu Zuoyi’s surprise attack on Bailingmiao won a decisive victory in the Suiyuan campaign and triggered nationwide support.

description.zh:
1936 年 11 月 23 日夜，傅作义部在严寒中长途奔袭百灵庙，经一夜激战于 24 日攻克该地，歼灭伪蒙军一部并缴获大量物资。百灵庙大捷震动全国，各界纷纷组织慰问与捐款，成为绥远抗战的标志性胜利。

日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On the night of 23 November 1936 Fu Zuoyi’s troops marched through severe cold to surprise Bailingmiao and, after a night of fighting, took it on 24 November, destroying part of the Mengjiang force and capturing large quantities of supplies. The victory caused a national sensation, with organizations across the country sending condolences and donations, and became the emblematic success of the Suiyuan campaign.

Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 沈钧儒等七位救国会领袖在上海被捕，引发全国抗议。
summary.en: Seven leaders of the National Salvation Association, including Shen Junru, were arrested in Shanghai, prompting nationwide protests.

description.zh:
1936 年 11 月 23 日，南京国民政府以“危害民国”罪名在上海逮捕沈钧儒、章乃器、邹韬奋、李公朴、沙千里、史良、王造时七位救国会领袖，史称“七君子事件”。事件激起全国各界抗议，进一步推动了抗日救亡运动。

政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 23 November 1936 the Nanjing government arrested seven leaders of the National Salvation Association in Shanghai—Shen Junru, Zhang Naiqi, Zou Taofen, Li Gongpu, Sha Qianli, Shi Liang, and Wang Zaoshi—on charges of “endangering the Republic.” Known as the Seven Gentlemen Incident, the arrests provoked nationwide protests and further strengthened the national salvation movement.

A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.zh: 张学良、杨虎城在西安扣留蒋介石，促成停止内战、联共抗日的转折。
summary.en: Zhang Xueliang and Yang Hucheng detained Chiang Kai-shek in Xi’an, leading to a turn toward ending the civil war and resisting Japan.

description.zh:
1936 年 12 月 12 日，东北军将领张学良与第十七路军将领杨虎城在西安扣留蒋介石，要求停止内战、一致抗日。经多方斡旋，事变和平解决，为抗日民族统一战线的形成创造了条件。

本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
On 12 December 1936, Zhang Xueliang of the Northeast Army and Yang Hucheng of the 17th Route Army detained Chiang Kai-shek in Xi’an, demanding an end to the civil war and united resistance against Japan. The incident was resolved peacefully, helping pave the way for the anti-Japanese united front.

This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

name.en: The 29th Army and the defense of Lugouqiao

summary.zh: 第29军在卢沟桥奋起抵抗日军。
summary.en: The 29th Army resisted the Japanese at Lugouqiao.

description.zh: 1937 年 7 月 7 日卢沟桥事变后，第29军奋起抵抗，副军长佟麟阁、师长赵登禹在后续作战中阵亡。日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: After the Lugouqiao Incident on July 7, 1937, the 29th Army resisted the Japanese; deputy commander Tong Linge and division commander Zhao Dengyu were killed in subsequent fighting. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 日军在卢沟桥附近挑起冲突并进攻宛平城，中国全面抗战由此爆发。
summary.en: Japanese forces provoked a clash near the Marco Polo Bridge and attacked Wanping, marking the start of full-scale Chinese resistance.

description.zh:
1937 年 7 月 7 日夜，日军在北平西南卢沟桥附近演习，借口士兵失踪要求进入宛平城搜查，遭拒后发动进攻。中国守军第二十九军奋起抵抗，战事迅速扩大。

本事件为路线分段端点，日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On the night of 7 July 1937, Japanese troops on exercise near the Marco Polo Bridge demanded entry into Wanping to search for a missing soldier. After being refused, they attacked. The Chinese 29th Army resisted, and the fighting quickly escalated.

This event marks a route segment endpoint; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

summary.zh: 蒋介石发表庐山谈话，表示“地无分南北，年无分老幼，皆有守土抗战之责任”。
summary.en: Chiang Kai-shek’s Lushan statement declared that “regardless of north or south, young or old, everyone has the duty to defend the land and resist.”

description.zh:
1937 年 7 月 17 日，蒋介石在庐山发表谈话，提出解决卢沟桥事变的四项立场，并表示“如果战端一开，那就是地无分南北，年无分老幼，无论何人，皆有守土抗战之责任”。这被视为国民政府走向全面抗战的重要表态。

日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 17 July 1937 Chiang Kai-shek issued the Lushan Statement, setting out four conditions for settling the Marco Polo Bridge Incident and declaring that “if war begins, then regardless of north or south, young or old, everyone has the duty to defend the land and resist.” It is regarded as a key statement of the Nationalist government’s turn toward full-scale resistance.

Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

name.en: Relocation of Industry to the Interior

summary.zh: 抗战爆发后，沿海工厂大规模内迁四川、云南、贵州、陕西等地。
summary.en: After the war began, coastal factories were moved on a large scale to Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou, Shaanxi, and other interior provinces.

description.zh:
1937 年 8 月起，国民政府组织沿海工厂内迁，600 余家工厂、大批设备与技术工人迁往四川、云南、贵州、陕西等地，成为大后方工业基础。内迁过程艰苦，但保存了抗战所需的军工与民用生产能力。

日期与数字取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
From August 1937 the Nationalist government organized the relocation of coastal industry. More than 600 factories, large quantities of equipment, and skilled workers moved to Sichuan, Yunnan, Guizhou, Shaanxi, and other interior provinces, forming the industrial base of the rear area. The process was arduous but preserved military and civilian production capacity for the war.

Dates and figures follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Nankou, opening operations along the Beiping-Suiyuan railway.

description.zh: 1937 年 8 月，日军进攻河北南口，平绥线作战展开。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In August 1937, Japanese forces attacked Nankou, Hebei, opening operations along the Beiping-Suiyuan railway. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 第13军在南口抗击日军，掩护平绥线。
summary.en: The 13th Army resisted the Japanese at Nankou, covering the Beiping-Suiyuan railway.

description.zh: 1937 年 8 月，第13军（军长汤恩伯）在河北南口抗击日军，掩护平绥线。日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In August 1937, the 13th Army under Tang Enbo resisted Japanese forces at Nankou, Hebei, covering the Beiping-Suiyuan railway. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 中国海军在江阴段沉船封江，阻止日军溯江而上。
summary.en: The Chinese navy sank ships to block the Yangtze at Jiangyin and halt the Japanese advance upstream.

description.zh: 1937 年 8 月 12 日，中国海军在长江江阴段沉船封江，构筑封锁线，迟滞日军溯江进攻。舰艇数量与封锁细节为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On August 12, 1937, the Chinese navy sank ships to block the Yangtze at Jiangyin, constructing a blockade line to delay the Japanese advance upstream. Ship numbers and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

name.en: Establishment of the Supreme National Defense Council

summary.zh: 国民政府成立国防最高会议，作为战时最高决策机构。
summary.en: The Nationalist government established the Supreme National Defense Council as the top wartime decision-making body.

description.zh:
1937 年 8 月，国民政府成立国防最高会议，统筹军政大计；1939 年 2 月改组为国防最高委员会，蒋介石任委员长。它成为战时最高决策机构。

日期与沿革取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In August 1937 the Nationalist government established the Supreme National Defense Council to coordinate military and political affairs; in February 1939 it was reorganized as the Supreme National Defense Commission with Chiang Kai-shek as chairman. It became the top wartime decision-making body.

Dates and institutional details follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》

summary.zh: 中日双方在上海投入重兵鏖战三个月，中国军队粉碎了日军速战速决的企图。
summary.en: China and Japan poured troops into three months of fighting in Shanghai, thwarting Japan’s hope for a quick victory.

description.zh:
1937 年 8 月 13 日，淞沪会战爆发。中国军队先后投入数十万兵力，与日军在上海市区及周边反复争夺。11 月，中国军队西撤，上海沦陷，但会战打破了日军“三个月灭亡中国”的计划。

本事件为路线分段端点，日期与战果表述待史料校订。
description.en:
The Battle of Shanghai began on 13 August 1937. Hundreds of thousands of Chinese troops fought Japanese forces in and around the city. In November the Chinese army withdrew west and Shanghai fell, but the battle shattered Japan’s plan to conquer China in three months.

This event marks a route segment endpoint; dates and assessments await historical review.

description.en: On August 13, 1937, Japanese forces attacked Shanghai, beginning the Battle of Shanghai. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The 8th Group Army fought in the Battle of Shanghai in the Pudong sector.

description.zh: 1937 年 8 月，第8集团军（总司令张发奎）参加淞沪会战，在浦东方向作战。日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In August 1937, the 8th Group Army under Zhang Fakui fought in the Battle of Shanghai in the Pudong sector. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 中国空军在笕桥上空迎战日军，取得空战战果。
summary.en: Chinese air forces engaged Japanese aircraft over Jianqiao and scored a combat success.

description.zh: 1937 年 8 月 14 日，中国空军第四大队在浙江杭州笕桥上空迎战日军飞机，取得空战战果。大队长高志航率队参战。战果数字为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On August 14, 1937, the Chinese Air Force’s 4th Group engaged Japanese aircraft over Jianqiao, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, scoring a combat success. Group commander Gao Zhihang led the sortie. Casualty figures follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The 9th Group Army fought in the Battle of Shanghai, attacking Hongkou and Yangshupu.

description.zh: 1937 年 8 月，第9集团军（总司令张治中）参加淞沪会战，进攻虹口、杨树浦方向。日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In August 1937, the 9th Group Army under Zhang Zhizhong fought in the Battle of Shanghai, attacking toward Hongkou and Yangshupu. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Establishment of the First War Zone

summary.zh: 第一战区成立，负责平汉线北段作战。
summary.en: The First War Zone was established to direct operations along the northern Jin-Pu railway.

description.zh: 1937 年 8 月 20 日，国民政府军事委员会划分战区，第一战区负责平汉线北段，蒋介石兼任司令长官，后由程潜接任。日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On August 20, 1937, the National Military Council divided the front into war zones. The First War Zone was responsible for the northern section of the Beijing-Hankou railway, with Chiang Kai-shek concurrently as commander and later Cheng Qian. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

name.en: Establishment of the Second War Zone

summary.zh: 第二战区成立，负责山西、绥远方向作战。
summary.en: The Second War Zone was established for operations in Shanxi and Suiyuan.

description.zh: 1937 年 8 月 20 日，第二战区成立，负责山西、绥远方向，阎锡山任司令长官。日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On August 20, 1937, the Second War Zone was established for the Shanxi and Suiyuan directions, with Yan Xishan as commander. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Establishment of the Third War Zone

summary.zh: 第三战区成立，负责淞沪方向作战。
summary.en: The Third War Zone was established for operations around Shanghai.

description.zh: 1937 年 8 月 20 日，第三战区成立，负责淞沪方向，冯玉祥任司令长官，后由顾祝同接任。日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On August 20, 1937, the Third War Zone was established for the Shanghai direction, with Feng Yuxiang as commander and later Gu Zhutong. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

aliases.zh: 中共中央政治局扩大会议

summary.zh: 中共中央在洛川冯家村召开政治局扩大会议，确定八路军「独立自主的山地游击战」方针。
summary.en: The CCP Central Committee met at Fengjiacun, Luochuan, and set the Eighth Route Army’s strategy of “independent mountain guerrilla warfare.”

description.zh:
1937 年 8 月 22 日至 25 日，中共中央在陕北洛川冯家村召开政治局扩大会议。会议通过《抗日救国十大纲领》和《关于目前形势与党的任务的决定》，确定红军改编后的战略方针为「独立自主的山地游击战」，包括在有利条件下集中兵力消灭敌人兵团和在平原发展游击战争，但着重于山地；作战原则是「分散以发动群众，集中以消灭敌人，打得赢就打，打不赢就走」。会议同时强调抗日民族统一战线中的独立自主原则，决定红军主力出动，并留一部分保卫陕甘宁边区。

会上对游击战与运动战的主次仍有不同意见，因部队急于出动未及充分讨论；方针表述以《毛泽东选集》第二卷所收《为动员一切力量争取抗战胜利而斗争》及中央档案馆藏件为准。会议地点在冯家村，不在洛川县城。
description.en:
From 22 to 25 August 1937 the CCP Central Committee held an enlarged Politburo meeting at Fengjiacun, Luochuan, northern Shaanxi. It adopted the Ten-Point Program for Resisting Japan and the Resolution on the Present Situation and the Party’s Tasks, and fixed the Red Army’s post-reorganization strategy as “independent mountain guerrilla warfare,” including concentrating forces to destroy enemy formations under favourable conditions and developing guerrilla warfare on the plains, but with emphasis on the mountains. The operational principle was “disperse to mobilize the people, concentrate to destroy the enemy; fight if you can win, move away if you cannot.” The meeting also stressed independence within the united front, decided that the main Red Army forces would go to the front, and left part of the force to defend the Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia border region.

Views on the balance between guerrilla and mobile warfare still differed and were not fully debated because the troops had to move; the wording follows “Struggle to Mobilize All Forces for Victory in the War of Resistance” in Selected Works of Mao Zedong, vol. 2, and documents held by the Central Archives. The venue was Fengjiacun, not Luochuan county town.

summary.zh: 第18军在罗店与日军反复争夺。
summary.en: The 18th Army fought repeated battles for Luodian.

description.zh: 1937 年 8 月 23 日，第18军（军长罗卓英）在上海罗店与日军反复争夺。日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On August 23, 1937, the 18th Army under Luo Zhuoying fought repeated battles with Japanese forces at Luodian, Shanghai. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

name.en: Establishment of the Eighth Route Army

summary.zh: 红军主力改编为国民革命军第八路军，下辖第115、第120、第129师。
summary.en: The main Red Army forces were reorganized as the Eighth Route Army, with the 115th, 120th, and 129th divisions.

description.zh:
1937 年 8 月 22 日，国民政府军事委员会宣布红军主力改编为国民革命军第八路军；8 月 25 日，中共中央军委发布改编命令，朱德任总指挥，彭德怀任副总指挥，叶剑英任参谋长，左权任副参谋长，任弼时任政治部主任，邓小平任副主任，下辖第115、第120、第129 师。红军总部在陕西泾阳云阳镇完成改编，各师自 8 月下旬起陆续誓师东渡黄河，开赴山西抗日前线。

改编日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
On 22 August 1937 the National Government’s Military Commission announced the reorganization of the main Red Army forces into the Eighth Route Army; on 25 August the Central Military Commission issued the reorganization order, with Zhu De as commander, Peng Dehuai as deputy commander, Ye Jianying as chief of staff, Zuo Quan as deputy chief of staff, Ren Bishi as director of the Political Department and Deng Xiaoping as deputy director, under the 115th, 120th, and 129th divisions. The Red Army headquarters completed the reorganization at Yunyang, Jingyang, Shaanxi, and from late August the divisions crossed the Yellow River toward Shanxi.

Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 第74军在淞沪战场以第51、第58师为基干组建，后成为正面战场主力。
summary.en: The 74th Army was formed on the Songhu battlefield around the 51st and 58th Divisions and became a mainstay of the frontal war.

description.zh:
1937 年 9 月，第74军在淞沪战场以第51师、第58师为基干组建，俞济时任军长。此后参加南京保卫战、兰封会战、万家岭战斗、上高会战、常德会战与湘西会战，被称为“抗日铁军”。

建制事件，不单独绘制路线；日期与番号沿革待史料校订。
description.en:
In September 1937 the 74th Army was formed on the Songhu battlefield around the 51st and 58th Divisions, with Yu Jishi as commander. It later fought at Nanjing, Lanfeng, Wanjialing, Shanggao, Changde, and Xiangxi, and became known as the “iron army” of the resistance.

An organizational event with no separate route; dates and order of battle await historical review.

name.en: Sichuan Troops March Out to Resist Japan

summary.zh: 川军各部自四川分批出川，开赴山西、淞沪等抗日前线。
summary.en: Sichuan units left the province in successive waves for the Shanxi and Shanghai fronts.

description.zh:
1937 年 9 月起，川军各部陆续出川抗战。第22集团军（邓锡侯、孙震部）经川陕公路北上，开赴山西第二战区；第20军（杨森部）经长江东下，开赴淞沪战场。川军装备简陋，但作战顽强，伤亡惨重。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
From September 1937 Sichuan units left the province in successive waves. The 22nd Group Army under Deng Xihou and Sun Zhen moved north via the Sichuan–Shaanxi road to the 2nd War Zone in Shanxi, while the 20th Army under Yang Sen moved east along the Yangtze to the Shanghai front. Poorly equipped but tenacious, the Sichuan troops suffered heavy casualties.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.en: Guangxi Troops March Out to Resist Japan

summary.zh: 桂军第21集团军自广西出发，经武汉、徐州开赴淞沪战场。
summary.en: The Guangxi 21st Group Army left Guangxi via Wuhan and Xuzhou for the Shanghai front.

description.zh:
1937 年 9 月，桂军第21集团军（廖磊部）自桂林、柳州出发，经武汉、徐州开赴淞沪，10 月参加蕴藻浜反击战。桂军作战勇猛，但在日军优势火力下伤亡惨重。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In September 1937 the Guangxi 21st Group Army under Liao Lei left Guilin and Liuzhou via Wuhan and Xuzhou for Shanghai, and in October fought in the Yunzaobang counterattack. The Guangxi troops fought bravely but suffered heavy losses under Japanese firepower.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 国民政府军事委员会将八路军改称第18集团军，朱德任总司令。
summary.en: The Military Commission renamed the Eighth Route Army the 18th Group Army, with Zhu De as commander-in-chief.

description.zh:
1937 年 9 月 11 日，国民政府军事委员会将国民革命军第八路军改称第18集团军，朱德任总司令，彭德怀任副总司令。因八路军番号已深入民心，中共方面和民间仍多沿用“八路军”名称，作战序列与指挥关系不变。

日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
On 11 September 1937 the National Government’s Military Commission renamed the Eighth Route Army the 18th Group Army, with Zhu De as commander-in-chief and Peng Dehuai as deputy commander-in-chief. Because the name “Eighth Route Army” had already taken root, the Chinese Communist side and the public continued to use it; the order of battle and command relationships were unchanged.

Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团占领大同，随后沿同蒲路南下。
summary.en: The Japanese Kwantung Army’s Chahar expeditionary force took Datong and moved south along the Tongpu railway.

description.zh: 1937 年 9 月 13 日日军关东军察哈尔派遣兵团占领大同，晋北门户洞开；日军随后沿同蒲路南下，10 月 13 日猛攻忻口。
description.en: On 13 September 1937 the Kwantung Army’s Chahar force took Datong, opening northern Shanxi; the Japanese then moved south along the Tongpu railway and attacked Xinkou on 13 October.

name.en: Appeal to the League of Nations

summary.zh: 中国向国际联盟申诉日本侵略，援引盟约第十七条。
summary.en: China appealed to the League of Nations against Japanese aggression under Article 17 of the Covenant.

description.zh:
1937 年 9 月 13 日，中国向国际联盟申诉日本侵略，援引盟约第十七条，要求制裁。国联随后通过谴责日本、支持中国的决议，但缺乏强制力，未采取实际行动。

日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 13 September 1937 China appealed to the League of Nations against Japanese aggression under Article 17 of the Covenant and sought sanctions. The League adopted resolutions condemning Japan and supporting China, but they lacked enforcement and produced no practical action.

Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》

summary.zh: 日军第 5 师团占领灵丘，随即南下进攻平型关。
summary.en: The Japanese 5th Division took Lingqiu and moved south against Pingxingguan.

description.zh: 1937 年 9 月 20 日日军第 5 师团占领灵丘县城，随后沿灵丘—平型关大道南下；9 月 25 日八路军第 115 师在乔沟伏击其辎重部队，平型关战斗爆发。
description.en: On 20 September 1937 the Japanese 5th Division took Lingqiu county town and moved south along the Lingqiu–Pingxingguan road; on 25 September the 115th Division ambushed its supply column at Qiaogou.

sources.note: 第 5 师团进攻平型关

summary.zh: 日军进攻平型关，平型关战役展开。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Pingxing Pass, opening the Battle of Pingxing Pass.

description.zh: 1937 年 9 月，日军进攻山西平型关，平型关战役展开。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In September 1937, Japanese forces attacked Pingxing Pass in Shanxi, opening the Battle of Pingxing Pass. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The 6th Group Army in the Battle of Pingxing Pass

summary.zh: 第6集团军任右地区总司令，防守平型关一线。
summary.en: The 6th Group Army commanded the right sector, defending the Pingxing Pass line.

description.zh: 1937 年 9 月，第6集团军（总司令杨爱源）任右地区总司令，指挥平型关东西一线防御。日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In September 1937, the 6th Group Army under Yang Aiyuan commanded the right sector, directing the defense of the Pingxing Pass line. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 八路军第115师在平型关东北伏击日军，取得全面抗战初期的重要胜利。
summary.en: The 115th Division ambushed Japanese forces northeast of Pingxingguan, an important early victory of the full-scale war.

description.zh:
1937 年 9 月 25 日，八路军第115师（师长林彪、副师长聂荣臻）在山西灵丘平型关东北的乔沟一带伏击日军第5师团第21旅团一部及辎重部队，毙伤日军一部，击毁汽车、马车多辆，取得全面抗战初期中国军队主动出击的重要胜利。此战打破了“日军不可战胜”的神话，也提高了八路军在华北的声威。

参战兵力与战果各书记载不一，待页码级核对。
description.en:
On 25 September 1937 the 115th Division (commander Lin Biao, deputy commander Nie Rongzhen) ambushed a detachment of the Japanese 5th Division’s 21st Brigade and its supply train in the Qiaogou area northeast of Pingxingguan, Lingqiu, Shanxi, inflicting casualties and destroying trucks and carts. It was an important early victory won by Chinese forces taking the initiative, and it raised the Eighth Route Army’s prestige in North China.

Force sizes and results vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《中国人民解放军战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

name.zh: 川军第22集团军参加娘子关战斗

summary.zh: 川军第22集团军自四川北上，在娘子关一线参加保卫战。
summary.en: The Sichuan 22nd Group Army marched north and fought in the defense of Niangziguan.

description.zh:
1937 年 10 月，川军第22集团军经宝鸡、西安北上，在娘子关一线参加对日作战。川军装备低劣、补给困难，仍以重大伤亡迟滞日军。此后该部转赴山东，参加滕县保卫战。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In October 1937 the Sichuan 22nd Group Army moved north via Baoji and Xi’an and fought the Japanese at Niangziguan. Poorly equipped and badly supplied, it still delayed the Japanese at great cost. The army then moved to Shandong and fought in the defense of Tengxian.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.en: Establishment of the New Fourth Army

summary.zh: 南方八省红军游击队改编为国民革命军陆军新编第四军。
summary.en: Red Army guerrillas from eight southern provinces were reorganized as the New Fourth Army.

description.zh: 1937 年 10 月 12 日，国民政府军事委员会宣布将南方八省红军游击队改编为国民革命军陆军新编第四军，叶挺任军长，项英任副军长。日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On October 12, 1937, the National Military Council announced the reorganization of Red Army guerrillas from eight southern provinces as the New Fourth Army of the National Revolutionary Army, with Ye Ting as commander and Xiang Ying as deputy commander. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《中国人民解放军战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

summary.zh: 川军第20军经长江东下抵达淞沪，参加大场、蕴藻浜战斗。
summary.en: The Sichuan 20th Army moved east along the Yangtze to Shanghai and fought at Dachang and Yunzaobang.

description.zh:
1937 年 10 月，川军第20军（杨森部）经重庆、宜昌、武汉东下抵达淞沪，参加大场、蕴藻浜一带战斗。该军装备简陋，在日军火力下伤亡很大。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In October 1937 the Sichuan 20th Army under Yang Sen moved east via Chongqing, Yichang, and Wuhan to Shanghai and fought around Dachang and Yunzaobang. Poorly equipped, it suffered heavy casualties under Japanese fire.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 日军进攻忻口，忻口会战展开。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Xinkou, opening the Battle of Xinkou.

description.zh: 1937 年 10 月 13 日，日军进攻山西忻口，忻口会战展开。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On October 13, 1937, Japanese forces attacked Xinkou, Shanxi, opening the Battle of Xinkou. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《日本帝国主义侵华档案资料选编》
sources.author: 中央档案馆等编

sources.title: 《中国人民解放军战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

summary.zh: 第14集团军参加忻口会战。
summary.en: The 14th Group Army fought in the Battle of Xinkou.

description.zh: 1937 年 10 月，第14集团军（总司令卫立煌）参加忻口会战，在山西忻口一线抗击日军。日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In October 1937, the 14th Group Army under Wei Lihuang fought in the Battle of Xinkou, resisting Japanese forces along the Xinkou line in Shanxi. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 第6集团军在忻口右翼参加会战。
summary.en: The 6th Group Army fought on the right flank at Xinkou.

description.zh: 1937 年 10 月，第6集团军（总司令杨爱源）在忻口右翼参加会战。日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In October 1937, the 6th Group Army under Yang Aiyuan fought on the right flank at Xinkou. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 中国军队在忻口阻击日军，激战近一个月，忻口最终失守，太原随后沦陷。
summary.en: Chinese forces blocked the Japanese at Xinkou for nearly a month before the position fell and Taiyuan was lost.

description.zh:
1937 年 10 月，日军第五师团等部沿同蒲铁路南下，进攻忻口。中国第二战区部队在卫立煌指挥下依托阵地顽强抵抗，双方在忻口一线激战。日军久攻不下，后因娘子关失守、中国军队侧后受威胁，中国军队于 11 月 2 日撤退，太原于 11 月 8 日失守。此役是太原会战的重要组成部分。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In October 1937, Japanese forces including the 5th Division advanced south along the Datong–Pukou railway and attacked Xinkou. Chinese troops of the Second War Zone, commanded by Wei Lihuang, resisted stubbornly from prepared positions in fierce fighting around Xinkou. Unable to break through quickly, the Japanese exploited the fall of Niangziguan and threatened the Chinese flank and rear; Chinese forces withdrew on 2 November, and Taiyuan fell on 8 November. The battle was an important part of the Taiyuan campaign.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

sources.title: 《中国事变陆军作战史》
sources.author: 日本防卫厅防卫研修所战史室

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 八路军第120师第358旅在雁门关以南伏击日军运输队，切断忻口前线补给。
summary.en: The 358th Brigade of the 120th Division ambushed Japanese supply columns south of Yanmenguan, cutting the supply line to the Xinkou front.

description.zh:
1937 年 10 月，八路军第120师第358旅第716团在山西代县雁门关以南的黑石头沟地区连续两次设伏，袭击日军往返于大同、忻口之间的汽车运输队，一度切断日军补给线，配合了正面战场的忻口防御作战。

参战部队、日期与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
In October 1937 the 716th Regiment of the 358th Brigade, 120th Division, set ambushes twice in the Heishitougou area south of Yanmenguan, Daixian, Shanxi, attacking Japanese truck convoys between Datong and Xinkou. The attacks temporarily cut the Japanese supply line and supported the Xinkou defense on the regular front.

Units, dates, and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 桂军第21集团军等在蕴藻浜一线反击日军，伤亡惨重。
summary.en: The Guangxi 21st Group Army and other units counterattacked along Yunzaobang at heavy cost.

description.zh:
1937 年 10 月中下旬，中国军队在蕴藻浜一线反击日军，桂军第21集团军等部投入战斗。由于日军火力占优，反击未能奏效，桂军伤亡惨重。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In mid-to-late October 1937 Chinese forces counterattacked along Yunzaobang, with the Guangxi 21st Group Army and others committed. Japanese firepower prevailed, the counterattack failed, and the Guangxi troops suffered heavy casualties.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 八路军第129师第769团夜袭阳明堡机场，毁伤日军飞机 24 架。
summary.en: The 769th Regiment of the 129th Division raided Yangmingbao airfield at night, destroying or damaging 24 Japanese aircraft.

description.zh:
1937 年 10 月 19 日夜，八路军第129师第769团（团长陈锡联）突袭山西代县阳明堡日军机场，毁伤飞机 24 架，歼灭机场警卫分队百余人，打击了日军在忻口方向的空中支援。

日期、战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
On the night of 19 October 1937 the 769th Regiment of the 129th Division (commander Chen Xilian) raided the Japanese airfield at Yangmingbao, Daixian, Shanxi, destroying or damaging 24 aircraft and killing more than a hundred airfield guards, thereby reducing Japanese air support for the Xinkou front.

Dates and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 八路军第129师第386旅在七亘村连续两次重叠设伏，打击日军辎重部队。
summary.en: The 386th Brigade of the 129th Division ambushed Japanese supply troops twice at the same spot near Qigencun.

description.zh:
1937 年 10 月 26 日和 28 日，八路军第129师第386旅第772团在山西平定县七亘村连续两次设伏，袭击向平定方向运送物资的日军第20师团辎重部队，毙伤日军数百人。刘伯承将这种在同一地点重复设伏的战法称为“重叠设伏”。

日期、番号与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
On 26 and 28 October 1937 the 772nd Regiment of the 386th Brigade, 129th Division, ambushed Japanese 20th Division supply troops carrying matériel toward Pingding at Qigencun, Shanxi, inflicting several hundred casualties. Liu Bocheng called this repeated ambush at the same site “overlapping ambush.”

Dates, unit designations, and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 九国公约会议在布鲁塞尔召开，中国呼吁制裁日本，未获实质结果。
summary.en: The Nine-Power Treaty Conference met in Brussels; China called for sanctions on Japan but achieved no substantive result.

description.zh:
1937 年 11 月，九国公约会议在布鲁塞尔召开，中国代表顾维钧呼吁制裁日本，但会议仅通过泛泛决议，未采取实际行动。中国转而更多寻求苏联、美国等双边援助。

会议是九国公约签字国召开的多边会议，中国是参加国和申诉方，但会议本身不是中国政府的决策。

国际事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In November 1937 the Nine-Power Treaty Conference met in Brussels. Chinese representative Wellington Koo called for sanctions on Japan, but the conference adopted only general resolutions and took no practical action. China increasingly turned to bilateral aid from the Soviet Union and the United States.

The conference was a multilateral meeting of the Nine-Power Treaty signatories; China was a participant and complainant, but the conference itself was not a decision of the Chinese government.

An international event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.en: Establishment of the Jin-Cha-Ji Military Region

summary.zh: 晋察冀军区在阜平成立，开辟华北第一个敌后抗日根据地。
summary.en: The Jin-Cha-Ji Military Region was established at Fuping, opening North China’s first base area behind enemy lines.

description.zh:
1937 年 11 月 7 日，根据中共中央和中央军委命令，晋察冀军区在河北阜平成立，聂荣臻任司令员兼政治委员，统一领导以五台山、阜平为中心的敌后武装。11 月下旬，日军调集 2 万余人分八路围攻，军区部队以游击战和集中主力歼敌相结合，粉碎围攻，根据地扩展到 30 余县，成为华北第一个敌后抗日根据地。

日期、兵力与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
On 7 November 1937, by order of the CCP Central Committee and Central Military Commission, the Jin-Cha-Ji Military Region was established at Fuping, Hebei, with Nie Rongzhen as commander and political commissar. In late November Japanese forces totaling more than 20,000 attacked in eight routes; the region’s troops combined guerrilla warfare with concentrated attacks, broke the encirclement, and expanded the base to more than 30 counties, making it North China’s first base area behind enemy lines.

Dates, force sizes, and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

description.zh: 1937 年 11 月，日军进攻山西太原，11 月 8 日太原失守。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In November 1937, Japanese forces attacked Taiyuan, Shanxi, which fell on November 8. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 第7集团军参加太原保卫战。
summary.en: The 7th Group Army fought in the defense of Taiyuan.

sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 太原失守后，八路军总部在石拐镇部署三师分兵，由正规战转向敌后游击战。
summary.en: After the fall of Taiyuan, the Eighth Route Army headquarters at Shiguan deployed its three divisions to disperse behind enemy lines and shift from regular to guerrilla warfare.

description.zh:
1937 年 11 月 8 日太原失守，华北以国民党为主体的正规战争基本结束。11 日，朱德在山西和顺石拐镇主持召开八路军总部领导干部会议，彭德怀、任弼时、左权、刘伯承、张浩、宋任穷等出席，决定第120师以管涔山为支点创建晋西北根据地，第115师主力转至吕梁山创建晋西南根据地，第129师与第115师一部依托太行、太岳山创建晋冀豫根据地。13 日，刘伯承主持召开第129师干部会议，部署「化整为零」、分兵发动群众。会后八路军三大主力由正规战转入游击战，分区挺进敌后。

会议日期、与会人员与各师分区分工为通行说法，石拐镇坐标按和顺县位置示意，均待页码级核对。
description.en:
Taiyuan fell on 8 November 1937, ending the phase in which Nationalist regular forces bore the main burden in North China. On 11 November Zhu De chaired a headquarters conference of senior commanders at Shiguan, Heshun, Shanxi—attended by Peng Dehuai, Ren Bishi, Zuo Quan, Liu Bocheng, Zhang Hao, and Song Renqiong—which assigned the 120th Division to build the northwestern Shanxi base around the Guancen Mountains, the main force of the 115th Division to build the southwestern Shanxi base in the Lüliang Mountains, and the 129th Division with part of the 115th to build the Jin-Ji-Yu base in the Taihang and Taiyue mountains. On 13 November Liu Bocheng chaired a 129th Division cadres’ meeting and ordered units to “break into pieces,” disperse, and mobilize the population. The three main divisions then shifted from regular to guerrilla warfare and moved into the Japanese rear in separate areas.

Dates, attendees, and area assignments follow conventional accounts; the Shiguan coordinates are schematic, based on Heshun county, and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 国民政府宣言迁都重庆，以西南为大后方坚持抗战。
summary.en: The Nationalist government declared Chongqing the wartime capital and made the southwest its rear base.

description.zh:
1937 年 11 月 20 日，国民政府发表迁都重庆宣言，随后军政机关、工厂、学校陆续西迁。1940 年 9 月 6 日，重庆被明定为陪都，成为战时政治、军事与经济中心。

日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 20 November 1937 the Nationalist government declared the capital moved to Chongqing, and government offices, factories, and schools moved west in succession. On 6 September 1940 Chongqing was formally designated the wartime capital, becoming the political, military, and economic center of the rear area.

Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.zh: 南京安全区与国际救援
name.en: Nanjing Safety Zone and International Relief

summary.zh: 南京安全区国际委员会设立难民区，收容难民、提供救济并记录日军暴行。
summary.en: The International Committee for the Nanjing Safety Zone set up a refugee zone, provided relief, and documented Japanese atrocities.

description.zh:
1937 年 11 月，南京安全区国际委员会成立，划设安全区，由约翰·拉贝、明妮·魏特琳等外籍人士主持，收容大批难民，提供粮食、医疗与庇护，并记录日军暴行。安全区在南京沦陷后继续运作到 1938 年初。

政治/人道事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In November 1937 the International Committee for the Nanjing Safety Zone was formed to establish a refugee zone. Led by foreigners including John Rabe and Minnie Vautrin, it sheltered large numbers of refugees, provided food, medical care, and protection, and documented Japanese atrocities. The zone continued to operate into early 1938 after the city fell.

A political and humanitarian event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 日军攻占南京，南京保卫战失败，守军突围。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Nanjing after the defense failed, and the Chinese garrison broke out.

description.zh:
1937 年 12 月，中国军队进行南京保卫战。12 月 13 日日军攻占南京，守军突围，部分官兵滞留城内。此后日军对平民和战俘实施大规模屠杀、强奸与劫掠，即南京大屠杀。

本事件为路线分段端点；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In December 1937 Chinese forces fought the defense of Nanjing. On 13 December Japanese forces captured the city, the garrison broke out, and some soldiers remained trapped. Japanese forces then carried out mass killings, rape, and looting against civilians and prisoners of war—the Nanjing Massacre.

This event marks a route segment endpoint; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 日军攻占南京后对平民和战俘实施大规模屠杀、强奸与劫掠，造成惨重伤亡。
summary.en: After capturing Nanjing, Japanese forces carried out mass killings, rape, and looting against civilians and prisoners of war.

description.zh:
1937 年 12 月 13 日日军攻占南京后，在数周内对放下武器的中国军人和无辜平民实施大规模屠杀、强奸、纵火与抢劫。远东国际军事法庭认定伤亡规模巨大。具体伤亡数字存在不同统计口径，待史料校订。

惨案事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法。
description.en:
After capturing Nanjing on 13 December 1937, Japanese forces carried out mass killings, rape, arson, and looting against disarmed Chinese soldiers and civilians over several weeks. The International Military Tribunal for the Far East found the scale of the atrocities to be enormous. Casualty figures vary among accounts and await historical review.

An atrocity event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts.

summary.zh: 第五战区司令长官部驻徐州，统一指挥津浦线作战。
summary.en: The Fifth War Zone headquarters was based at Xuzhou, directing operations along the Jinpu railway.

description.zh: 1938 年初，第五战区司令长官部驻江苏徐州，李宗仁任司令长官，统一指挥津浦铁路沿线作战。时间与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In early 1938, the Fifth War Zone headquarters was based at Xuzhou, Jiangsu, with Li Zongren as commander, directing operations along the Jinpu railway. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军在青岛登陆，随后沿胶济路西进。
summary.en: The Japanese landed at Qingdao and moved west along the Jiaoji railway.

description.zh: 1938 年 1 月 10 日日军海军陆战队在青岛登陆，中国守军已撤离，日军随即沿胶济路西进，为进攻临沂、徐州做准备。
description.en: On 10 January 1938 Japanese marines landed at Qingdao, the Chinese garrison having withdrawn; the Japanese then moved west along the Jiaoji railway in preparation for the attacks on Linyi and Xuzhou.

name.zh: 晋察冀边区行政委员会成立
name.en: Establishment of the Jin-Cha-Ji Border Region Government

aliases.en: Founding of the Jin-Cha-Ji Border Government

summary.zh: 晋察冀边区军政民代表大会在阜平召开，成立敌后第一个抗日民主政权。
summary.en: The Jin-Cha-Ji border region congress met at Fuping and established the first anti-Japanese democratic government behind enemy lines.

description.zh:
1938 年 1 月 10 日至 15 日，晋察冀边区军政民代表大会在河北阜平召开，选举产生晋察冀边区临时行政委员会，宋劭文任主任委员。这是中国共产党在华北敌后建立的第一个统一战线性质的抗日民主政权，同年 1 月 31 日经国民政府批准改称晋察冀边区行政委员会。

代表人数与日期细节各书略有出入，待页码级核对。
description.en:
From 10 to 15 January 1938 the Jin-Cha-Ji border region military-civilian congress met at Fuping, Hebei, and elected the Jin-Cha-Ji Border Region Provisional Administrative Committee with Song Shaowen as chairman. It was the first united-front anti-Japanese democratic government established by the CCP behind enemy lines in North China; on 31 January it was approved by the National Government and renamed the Jin-Cha-Ji Border Region Administrative Committee.

Delegate counts and date details vary slightly between accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 第120师在晋西北开辟晋绥根据地，屏障陕甘宁与华北通道。
summary.en: The 120th Division opened the Jin-Sui base area in northwestern Shanxi, shielding the Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia border region and the North China corridor.

description.zh:
1938 年初，八路军第120师在师长贺龙、政治委员关向应率领下，依托晋西北地区开辟晋绥抗日根据地，控制同蒲铁路北段与黄河东岸，成为陕甘宁边区的重要屏障和华北各根据地之间的联系通道。

具体成立日期与辖区范围各书记载不一，待页码级核对。
description.en:
In early 1938 the 120th Division, under commander He Long and political commissar Guan Xiangying, opened the Jin-Sui anti-Japanese base area in northwestern Shanxi, controlling the northern section of the Tongpu railway and the east bank of the Yellow River. It became an important shield for the Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia border region and a link between North China base areas.

Exact founding dates and territorial extent vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

description.zh: 1938 年 1 月，中国第一个机械化师第 200 师在湖南湘潭成立，杜聿明任师长。成立时间与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In January 1938, China’s first mechanized division, the 200th Division, was formed at Xiangtan, Hunan, with Du Yuming as commander. The date and appointment follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军对重庆进行长达五年半的战略轰炸，造成大量平民伤亡。
summary.en: Japan carried out a strategic bombing campaign against Chongqing for five and a half years, causing heavy civilian casualties.

description.zh:
1938 年 2 月至 1943 年 8 月，日军对重庆进行长期战略轰炸，旨在摧毁中国战时首都的抗战意志。轰炸造成大量平民伤亡与财产损失，1941 年 6 月 5 日发生大隧道惨案。

日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
From February 1938 to August 1943 Japan conducted a prolonged strategic bombing campaign against Chongqing aimed at breaking the will of China’s wartime capital. The bombing caused heavy civilian casualties and material losses; the Daxuidao tunnel disaster occurred on 5 June 1941.

Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.en: Air Defense and Relief in Chongqing

summary.zh: 重庆军民在长期轰炸下组织防空、疏散、救火与救济，坚持战时首都的运转。
summary.en: Under prolonged bombing, Chongqing’s soldiers and civilians organized air defense, evacuation, firefighting, and relief to keep the wartime capital functioning.

description.zh:
1938 年至 1943 年，重庆在日军长期轰炸下建立防空警报、防空洞与疏散体系，组织消防、医疗与难民救济。1941 年 6 月 5 日大隧道惨案后，各界展开救援与善后。重庆军民在轰炸中坚持抗战，维持战时首都的运转。

政治/社会事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
From 1938 to 1943 Chongqing built air-raid warning, shelter, and evacuation systems under prolonged Japanese bombing, and organized firefighting, medical care, and refugee relief. After the Daxuidao tunnel disaster of 5 June 1941, relief and recovery efforts were undertaken. Soldiers and civilians persisted through the bombing and kept the wartime capital functioning.

A political and social event with no route drawn; dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: The Sichuan 22nd Group Army held Tengxian stubbornly, buying time for the Taierzhuang campaign.

description.zh:
1938 年 3 月，川军第22集团军第41军王铭章部在滕县死守，与日军第10师团激战。滕县于 3 月 17 日陷落，王铭章殉国，但川军的抵抗为台儿庄会战争取了部署时间。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In March 1938 the 41st Army of the Sichuan 22nd Group Army, under Wang Mingzhang, held Tengxian against the Japanese 10th Division. The town fell on 17 March and Wang was killed, but the resistance bought time for the Chinese deployment at Taierzhuang.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 中国军队在台儿庄地区重创日军，取得正面战场的一次重大胜利。
summary.en: Chinese forces inflicted a major defeat on Japanese troops at Taierzhuang, a significant victory on the frontal battlefield.

description.zh:
1938 年 3 月至 4 月，中国军队在第五战区司令长官李宗仁指挥下，于山东台儿庄地区与日军第十师团等部激战，最终取得台儿庄大捷。此役是徐州会战的重要组成部分。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
From March to April 1938, Chinese forces under Li Zongren, commander of the Fifth War Zone, fought Japanese units including the 10th Division at Taierzhuang in Shandong, winning a major victory. The battle was an important part of the Xuzhou campaign.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts and await historical review.
