summary.zh: 八路军第129师第386旅在神头岭伏击日军第108师团一部。
summary.en: The 386th Brigade of the 129th Division ambushed part of the Japanese 108th Division at Shentouling.

description.zh:
1938 年 3 月 16 日，八路军第129师第386旅在山西潞城神头岭设伏，袭击由潞城出援的日军第108师团一部，毙伤日军千余人，缴获大批军用物资。此战与响堂铺、长乐村等战斗共同粉碎了日军对晋东南的九路围攻。

战果数字为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
On 16 March 1938 the 386th Brigade of the 129th Division ambushed part of the Japanese 108th Division as it moved out from Lucheng at Shentouling, Shanxi, inflicting over a thousand casualties and capturing large quantities of supplies. Together with the battles at Xiangtangpu and Changlecun, it helped break the Japanese nine-route offensive in southeastern Shanxi.

Casualty figures follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The 129th Division ambushed a Japanese supply convoy at Xiangtangpu, burning more than a hundred trucks.

description.zh:
1938 年 3 月 31 日，八路军第129师在河北涉县响堂铺伏击日军第108师团运输车队，焚毁汽车 180 余辆，毙伤日军数百人，是晋东南反九路围攻中的重要战斗。

日期与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
On 31 March 1938 the 129th Division ambushed a supply convoy of the Japanese 108th Division at Xiangtangpu, Shexian, Hebei, burning more than 180 trucks and inflicting several hundred casualties. It was an important action in the counter-offensive against the nine-route encirclement in southeastern Shanxi.

Dates and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 第129师在晋东南开辟晋冀鲁豫根据地，形成太行、太岳、冀南三大区。
summary.en: The 129th Division opened the Jin-Ji-Lu-Yu base area in southeastern Shanxi, later divided into the Taihang, Taiyue, and southern Hebei regions.

description.zh:
1938 年 4 月，八路军第129师在师长刘伯承、政治委员邓小平率领下，粉碎日军对晋东南的九路围攻后，依托太行山地区开辟晋冀鲁豫抗日根据地，随后发展为太行、太岳、冀南等区，成为华北敌后面积最大、人口最多的根据地之一。

成立时间与辖区范围各书记载不一，待页码级核对。
description.en:
In April 1938 the 129th Division, under commander Liu Bocheng and political commissar Deng Xiaoping, broke the Japanese nine-route offensive in southeastern Shanxi and opened the Jin-Ji-Lu-Yu base area in the Taihang Mountains. It later grew into the Taihang, Taiyue, and southern Hebei regions and became one of the largest and most populous base areas behind enemy lines in North China.

Founding dates and territorial extent vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Program of Resistance and National Reconstruction

summary.zh: 国民党临时全国代表大会通过《抗战建国纲领》，确定战时内外政策。
summary.en: The Kuomintang’s extraordinary national congress adopted the Program of Resistance and National Reconstruction, setting wartime domestic and foreign policy.

description.zh:
1938 年 3 月至 4 月，国民党临时全国代表大会在武汉召开，蒋介石任总裁，通过《抗战建国纲领》，提出抗战与建国并行的方针，涉及外交、军事、政治、经济、教育等方面。

日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
From March to April 1938 the Kuomintang held an extraordinary national congress in Wuhan, elected Chiang Kai-shek as party leader, and adopted the Program of Resistance and National Reconstruction, which set out parallel goals of resistance and reconstruction in foreign policy, military affairs, politics, economy, and education.

Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

In April 1938 Peking University, Tsinghua University, and Nankai University formed the National Southwest Associated University in Kunming. Despite difficult conditions it continued teaching and research and trained a generation of talent during the war.

summary.en: The 129th Division pursued and destroyed Japanese forces at Changlecun, breaking the nine-route encirclement.

description.zh:
1938 年 4 月 16 日，八路军第129师主力在山西武乡长乐村一带追歼日军第108师团一部，毙伤日军 2200 余人，是粉碎日军对晋东南九路围攻的决定性战斗。

On 16 April 1938 the main force of the 129th Division pursued and destroyed part of the Japanese 108th Division near Changlecun, Wuxiang, Shanxi, inflicting more than 2,200 casualties. It was the decisive battle in breaking the Japanese nine-route offensive in southeastern Shanxi.

Casualty figures follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Directive on Guerrilla Warfare on the Plains

summary.zh: 毛泽东、张闻天、刘少奇致电八路军，提出在河北、山东平原大力发展游击战争。
summary.en: Mao Zedong, Zhang Wentian, and Liu Shaoqi instructed the Eighth Route Army to develop guerrilla warfare widely on the Hebei and Shandong plains.

description.zh:
1938 年 4 月 21 日，毛泽东、张闻天、刘少奇致电朱德、彭德怀、刘伯承、徐向前、邓小平等，指出根据抗战以来的经验，在河北、山东平原地区广大地发展游击战争是可能的；党和八路军应坚决采取尽量广大发展游击战争的方针，在平原划分游击军区、成立游击司令部，广泛组织不脱离生产的自卫军，并在收复地区建立抗日民主政权。这一指示把洛川会议提出的「在平原发展游击战争」由原则变为具体部署，随后第129师等部向冀南、冀中、冀东和山东平原展开。

电报文本以中央档案馆藏件为准；受电人名单各书略有出入。
description.en:
On 21 April 1938 Mao Zedong, Zhang Wentian, and Liu Shaoqi telegraphed Zhu De, Peng Dehuai, Liu Bocheng, Xu Xiangqian, Deng Xiaoping, and others, stating that experience since the war began showed guerrilla warfare could be developed widely on the Hebei and Shandong plains. The Party and the Eighth Route Army were to adopt a policy of the widest possible guerrilla development: divide the plains into guerrilla military regions, set up guerrilla headquarters, organize broad unarmed self-defence corps, and establish anti-Japanese democratic governments in recovered areas. The directive turned the Luochuan Conference’s principle of “developing guerrilla warfare on the plains” into a concrete deployment; the 129th Division and other forces then moved into southern and central Hebei, eastern Hebei, and the Shandong plain.

The text follows the document held by the Central Archives; recipient lists vary slightly between accounts.

summary.zh: 滇军第60军在禹王山一线抗击日军，掩护徐州会战主力转移。
summary.en: The Yunnan 60th Army held Yuwangshan, covering the withdrawal of the main forces in the Xuzhou campaign.

description.zh:
1938 年 4 月，滇军第60军抵达徐州后投入禹王山战斗，与日军第5、第10师团激战近一个月，伤亡惨重但守住了阵地，为徐州会战主力转移争取了时间。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In April 1938 the Yunnan 60th Army reached Xuzhou and fought at Yuwangshan against the Japanese 5th and 10th Divisions for nearly a month. Though badly mauled, it held its positions and bought time for the main forces to withdraw from the Xuzhou campaign.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.en: The 129th Division Marches into Southern Hebei

summary.zh: 徐向前率第129师路东纵队由辽县出发，穿越平汉铁路进入冀南平原。
summary.en: Xu Xiangqian led the 129th Division’s east-of-railway column from Liaoxian across the Pinghan railway into the southern Hebei plain.

description.zh:
1938 年 4 月 21 日平原游击战指示下达后，第129师决定以平汉铁路为界编成左右两路纵队：徐向前率第769团、第115师第689团及曾国华支队组成路东纵队，向冀南挺进；陈赓率第386旅主力组成路西纵队，向邢台、沙河一带展开。4 月 26 日路东纵队从辽县出发，穿越平汉铁路日军封锁线，5 月上旬到达南宫，与陈再道、宋任穷率领的东进纵队会合，随后发起威县战斗，冀南平原根据地初步形成。徐向前在冀南提出依托民众的「人山」思想，回答平原无山如何坚持游击战的问题。

到达南宫的日期各书记为 5 月 2 日、4 日或 7 日，此处取「5 月上旬」，待页码级核对。
description.en:
After the directive of 21 April 1938, the 129th Division divided its main force into two columns along the Pinghan railway. Xu Xiangqian led the east-of-railway column—the 769th Regiment, the 115th Division’s 689th Regiment, and the Zeng Guohua detachment—toward southern Hebei, while Chen Geng led the 386th Brigade west of the railway toward Xingtai and Shahe. The eastern column left Liaoxian on 26 April, crossed the Japanese blockade along the Pinghan railway, and reached Nangong in early May, joining Chen Zaidao’s and Song Renqiong’s Eastern Advance Column. It then attacked Weixian county town, and a base area on the southern Hebei plain began to take shape. At Nangong, Xu Xiangqian advanced the idea of a “mountain of people,” answering how guerrilla warfare could be sustained where there were no mountains.

Accounts give 2, 4, or 7 May for the arrival at Nangong; this entry uses “early May” pending page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军第 14 师团渡黄河南下占领菏泽。
summary.en: The Japanese 14th Division crossed the Yellow River and took Heze.

description.zh: 1938 年 5 月，日军第 14 师团（土肥原贤二）自濮阳渡黄河南下，5 月 14 日占领菏泽，随后向兰封、开封推进，引发兰封会战。
description.en: In May 1938 the Japanese 14th Division under Tsuchihashi (Dohihara’s 14th) crossed the Yellow River at Puyang and took Heze on 14 May, then pushed towards Lanfeng and Kaifeng, bringing on the Lanfeng battle.

sources.title: 中国事变陆军作战史

sources.note: 第 14 师团渡河与菏泽战斗

summary.zh: 中国军队围攻兰封日军第 14 师团，因日军增援与协同问题未能全歼，最终撤退。
summary.en: Chinese forces besieged the Japanese 14th Division at Lanfeng; Japanese reinforcements and coordination problems prevented a full encirclement, and the Chinese withdrew.

description.zh:
1938 年 5 月，徐州会战后期，中国军队在兰封地区围攻日军第 14 师团。中国军队一度收复兰封，但日军增援逼近，中国军队侧背受威胁，被迫撤退。此役是徐州会战的重要组成部分，也暴露了指挥协同与装备差距。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In May 1938, late in the Xuzhou campaign, Chinese forces besieged the Japanese 14th Division around Lanfeng. Chinese troops briefly recovered Lanfeng, but as Japanese reinforcements approached and threatened their flank and rear, they were forced to withdraw. The battle was an important part of the Xuzhou campaign and exposed gaps in command coordination and equipment.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.zh: 滇军第58军在云南成立，孙渡任军长，随后开赴赣北。
summary.en: The Yunnan 58th Army was formed with Sun Du as commander and soon moved to northern Jiangxi.

description.zh:
1938 年 6 月，为加强武汉会战兵力，滇军以 6 个团及常备训练团队在云南编成第58军，孙渡任军长。该军随后开赴赣北，隶属第9战区，参加南昌会战、长沙会战等。

建制事件，不单独绘制路线；日期与番号沿革待史料校订。
description.en:
In June 1938, to strengthen the forces for the Battle of Wuhan, the Yunnan military formed the 58th Army in Yunnan from six regiments and a standing training unit, with Sun Du as commander. It then moved to northern Jiangxi under the 9th War Zone and fought in the Nanchang and Changsha campaigns.

An organizational event with no separate route; dates and order of battle await historical review.

summary.zh: 兰封会战后期日军占领开封。
summary.en: The Japanese took Kaifeng in the later phase of the Lanfeng battle.

description.zh: 兰封会战后期，中国军队围攻土肥原第 14 师团未果，日军增援抵达，6 月 6 日占领开封，中国军队退守郑州以东，随后有花园口决堤。
description.en: In the later phase of the Lanfeng battle the Chinese army failed to destroy Dohihara’s 14th Division; Japanese reinforcements arrived and took Kaifeng on 6 June, the Chinese withdrawing east of Zhengzhou before the Huayuankou breach.

sources.title: 中国事变陆军作战史

name.zh: 八路军第四纵队挺进冀东
name.en: The Fourth Column Marches into Eastern Hebei

summary.zh: 宋时轮、邓华率八路军第四纵队由平西挺进冀东，策应冀东抗日暴动。
summary.en: Song Shilun and Deng Hua led the Fourth Column from Pingxi into eastern Hebei to support the Jidong uprising.

description.zh:
1938 年 6 月，八路军第四纵队（司令员宋时轮、政治委员邓华）约 5000 人由平西斋堂出发，穿越平绥铁路和潮白河，挺进冀东，策应中共冀热边特委领导的冀东抗日暴动。7 月暴动遍及 20 余县，第四纵队与冀东抗日联军一度攻克多座县城，8 月在遵化铁厂会师；9 月后因日军大举“围剿”，主力西撤平西，冀东抗战转入游击坚持。1939 年 2 月 7 日，以第四纵队为基础在平西成立八路军冀热察挺进军，萧克任司令员，第四纵队番号撤销；该部此后转战平西、平北、冀东，未进入山东。

参战兵力与日期细节各书记载不一，待页码级核对。
description.en:
In June 1938 the Fourth Column (commander Song Shilun, political commissar Deng Hua), about 5,000 strong, set out from Zhaitang in Pingxi, crossed the Beiping–Suiyuan railway and the Chaobai River, and entered eastern Hebei to support the Jidong anti-Japanese uprising led by the CCP Jirebian Special Committee. In July the uprising spread across more than 20 counties; the column and the Jidong Anti-Japanese United Army captured several county towns and met at Tiechang, Zunhua, in August. After September, under heavy Japanese pressure, the main force withdrew west to Pingxi and the struggle in Jidong shifted to guerrilla resistance. On 7 February 1939 the Jirecha Advance Army was formed at Pingxi on the Fourth Column’s basis under Xiao Ke, and the Fourth Column’s designation was abolished; the force subsequently operated in Pingxi, Pingbei, and Jidong and never entered Shandong.

Force sizes and dates vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 国民政府为阻日军西进，在郑州花园口炸开黄河大堤，造成严重水灾。
summary.en: The Nationalist government breached the Yellow River dike at Huayuankou to stop the Japanese advance, causing severe flooding.

description.zh:
1938 年 6 月，国民政府军事当局为阻止日军沿陇海路西进，在郑州花园口炸开黄河大堤，形成黄泛区。此举迟滞了日军进攻，但也造成豫皖苏大量平民伤亡与流离失所。

日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In June 1938 the Nationalist military authorities breached the Yellow River dike at Huayuankou near Zhengzhou to stop the Japanese advance along the Longhai railway, creating the Yellow River flood zone. The move delayed the Japanese but caused heavy civilian casualties and displacement in Henan, Anhui, and Jiangsu.

Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 国民参政会在汉口成立，成为战时民意咨询机构。
summary.en: The People’s Political Council was established in Hankou as a wartime advisory body representing public opinion.

description.zh:
1938 年 7 月 6 日，国民参政会第一届第一次会议在汉口召开，容纳各党派与无党派人士，成为战时民意咨询机构。它没有立法权，但为各派参与政治提供了渠道。

日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 6 July 1938 the first session of the People’s Political Council opened in Hankou, bringing together party and non-party figures as a wartime advisory body. It had no legislative power but provided a channel for various groups to participate in politics.

Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 第58军自云南经贵阳、长沙开赴赣北，参加第9战区作战。
summary.en: The 58th Army moved from Yunnan via Guiyang and Changsha to northern Jiangxi for operations in the 9th War Zone.

description.zh:
1938 年 9 月，第58军自云南经贵阳、长沙开赴赣北，隶属第9战区。此后长期转战赣北、湘北，参加南昌会战、长沙会战与赣北游击作战。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In September 1938 the 58th Army moved from Yunnan via Guiyang and Changsha to northern Jiangxi under the 9th War Zone. It then fought for years in northern Jiangxi and northern Hunan, taking part in the Nanchang and Changsha campaigns and guerrilla operations.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 日军第 2 军自六安西进占领商城。

description.zh: 1938 年 8 月底日军第 2 军自合肥、六安西进，沿大别山北麓进攻商城、潢川，9 月 16 日占领商城，随后转攻潢川、罗山，配合武汉会战。
description.en: In late August 1938 the Japanese 2nd Army advanced west from Hefei and Lu’an along the northern foot of the Dabie mountains against Shangcheng and Huangchuan, taking Shangcheng on 16 September and then turning on Huangchuan and Luoshan in support of the Wuhan campaign.

summary.zh: 第74军等部在万家岭重创日军第106师团。
summary.en: The 74th Army and other units mauled the Japanese 106th Division at Wanjialing.

description.zh:
1938 年 9 至 10 月，武汉会战期间，第74军等部在江西德安万家岭地区包围日军第106师团，经激战重创该部。万家岭大捷是武汉会战中的重要胜利，也使第74军声名大振。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In September and October 1938, during the Battle of Wuhan, the 74th Army and other units encircled and mauled the Japanese 106th Division at Wanjialing in De’an, Jiangxi. The victory was an important success in the Wuhan campaign and made the 74th Army famous.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 中国第一支机械化军在广西全州整编成军，杜聿明任军长。
summary.en: China’s first mechanized army was assembled at Quanzhou, Guangxi, with Du Yuming as commander.

description.zh:
1938 年 10 月，第5军在广西全州整编成军，辖第200师、新编第22师、荣誉第1师，杜聿明任军长，是中国第一支机械化部队。1939 年参加桂南会战、主攻昆仑关；1942 年作为远征军先头部队入缅。

建制事件，不单独绘制路线；日期与番号沿革待史料校订。
description.en:
In October 1938 the 5th Army was assembled at Quanzhou, Guangxi, with the 200th Division, New 22nd Division, and Honorary 1st Division under Du Yuming. It was China’s first mechanized army. In 1939 it fought in the Guangxi campaign and led the attack on Kunlun Pass; in 1942 it entered Burma as the spearhead of the Chinese Expeditionary Force.

An organizational event with no separate route; dates and order of battle await historical review.

summary.zh: 滇军第184师、新12师在长沙编成新3军，随后参加崇阳战斗。
summary.en: The Yunnan 184th and New 12th Divisions formed the New 3rd Army at Changsha and soon fought at Chongyang.

description.zh:
1938 年 10 月，滇军第184师、新编第12师在湖南长沙编成新3军，隶属第30军团。11 月在湖北崇阳作战失利，此后转战赣北、湘北，隶属第9战区。

建制事件，不单独绘制路线；日期与番号沿革待史料校订。
description.en:
In October 1938 the Yunnan 184th and New 12th Divisions formed the New 3rd Army at Changsha under the 30th Army Corps. It suffered a defeat at Chongyang in Hubei in November and then fought in northern Jiangxi and northern Hunan under the 9th War Zone.

An organizational event with no separate route; dates and order of battle await historical review.

summary.zh: 日军在大亚湾登陆，进攻广州。
summary.en: Japanese forces landed at Dayawan and attacked Guangzhou.

description.zh: 1938 年 10 月 12 日，日军第 21 军在大亚湾登陆，10 月 21 日广州失守。日期与部队为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: On October 12, 1938, the Japanese 21st Army landed at Dayawan and took Guangzhou on October 21. Dates and units follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

summary.zh: 日军第21军在大亚湾登陆后进攻广州，第12集团军在增城、广州外围抵抗，广州于 10 月 21 日失守。
summary.en: After landing at Daya Bay the Japanese 21st Army advanced on Guangzhou; the 12th Group Army resisted around Zengcheng and the city fell on 21 October.

description.zh:
1938 年 10 月 12 日，日军第21军在大亚湾登陆，沿广九铁路进攻广州。第12集团军（总司令余汉谋）在增城、广州外围抵抗，但兵力分散、准备不足，广州于 10 月 21 日失守。

日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
On 12 October 1938 the Japanese 21st Army landed at Daya Bay and advanced on Guangzhou along the Kowloon–Canton railway. The 12th Group Army under Yu Hanmou resisted around Zengcheng and the city’s outskirts, but with dispersed forces and insufficient preparation, Guangzhou fell on 21 October.

Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军在广东大亚湾登陆后迅速推进，占领广州，华南门户失守。
summary.en: Japanese forces landed at Daya Bay in Guangdong and quickly captured Guangzhou, opening the gateway to South China.

description.zh:
1938 年 10 月，日军在广东大亚湾登陆，沿公路向广州推进。10 月 21 日广州失守，中国南方重要港口与对外通道被日军控制。

本事件日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In October 1938, Japanese forces landed at Daya Bay in Guangdong and advanced along roads toward Guangzhou. The city fell on 21 October, placing an important southern port and external supply route under Japanese control.

Date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 武汉会战后日军占领武汉，抗日战争进入战略相持阶段。
summary.en: After the Battle of Wuhan, Japanese forces captured the city, and the war entered a phase of strategic stalemate.

description.zh:
1938 年 6 月起，日军沿长江南北进攻武汉。中国军队组织武汉会战，激战数月后于 10 月撤出。10 月 25 日武汉失守，国民政府机关此前已迁往重庆，抗日战争逐步进入战略相持阶段。

本事件为路线相关节点，日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
From June 1938, Japanese forces advanced on Wuhan from both sides of the Yangtze. Chinese troops fought the Battle of Wuhan for months before withdrawing in October. Wuhan fell on 25 October; government organs had already moved to Chongqing, and the war gradually entered a phase of strategic stalemate.

This event is linked to route segments; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.zh: 新3军在湖北崇阳作战失利，随后转往赣北。
summary.en: The New 3rd Army was defeated at Chongyang in Hubei and then moved to northern Jiangxi.

description.zh:
1938 年 11 月，新3军在湖北崇阳地区与日军作战失利，随后转往赣北、湘北，隶属第9战区，参加后续长沙会战。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In November 1938 the New 3rd Army was defeated by Japanese forces around Chongyang in Hubei. It then moved to northern Jiangxi and northern Hunan under the 9th War Zone and fought in later Changsha campaigns.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.en: Establishment of the Qiongya Independent Detachment

summary.zh: 琼崖红军游击队改编为抗日独立队，冯白驹任队长。
summary.en: The Qiongya Red Army guerrillas were reorganized as an anti-Japanese independent detachment under Feng Baiju.

description.zh:
1938 年 12 月 5 日，琼崖工农红军游击队在海南琼山云龙改编为广东民众抗日自卫团第十四区独立队，冯白驹任队长。日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。

本事件为建军建制，不绘制行军路线。
description.en:
On December 5, 1938, the Qiongya Workers’ and Peasants’ Red Army guerrillas were reorganized at Yunlong, Qiongshan, Hainan, as the Independent Detachment of the 14th District of the Guangdong People’s Anti-Japanese Self-Defense Corps, with Feng Baiju as commander. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

This is a force-formation event; no march route is drawn.

sources.title: 《中国人民解放军战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

summary.zh: 山东本地起义武装在沂水王庄整编为八路军山东纵队，统一指挥全省抗日武装。
summary.en: Shandong’s local uprising forces were reorganized at Wangzhuang, Yishui, as the Shandong Column, unifying the province’s anti-Japanese forces.

description.zh:
1938 年 12 月 27 日，中共中央决定在山东沂水王庄成立八路军山东纵队，统一指挥山东各地共产党领导的抗日武装（鲁西、冀鲁边另成系统）。张经武任指挥，黎玉任政治委员，王建安任副指挥，王彬任参谋长，江华任政治部主任，下辖第二、第三、第四、第五、第六、第八、第九、第十二支队等 10 个支队又 3 个团，共 2.45 万余人。这支部队以山东各地抗日武装起义（徂徕山、天福山、黑铁山、牛头镇等）的基干队伍为基础编成，不是由八路军主力入鲁后组建；1938 年 6 月各地起义武装已统一使用「八路军山东人民抗日游击队」番号，12 月改称山东纵队。1942 年 8 月，山东纵队改为山东军区；1943 年 3 月，山东军区与第115师合并为新的山东军区。本事件为建军建制，不绘制行军路线。

成立日期、主官与兵力为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
On 27 December 1938 the CCP Central Committee decided to establish the Eighth Route Army’s Shandong Column at Wangzhuang, Yishui, to command the Communist-led anti-Japanese forces across Shandong (western Shandong and the Hebei-Shandong border area remained separate). Zhang Jingwu was commander, Li Yu political commissar, Wang Jian’an deputy commander, Wang Bin chief of staff, and Jiang Hua director of the political department, with ten detachments and three regiments—more than 24,500 men. The column was formed from the cadre units of Shandong’s local anti-Japanese uprisings (Culaishan, Tianfushan, Heitieshan, Niutouzhen, and others); it was not created by a main-force unit entering the province. In June 1938 the uprising forces had already adopted the designation “Eighth Route Army Shandong People’s Anti-Japanese Guerrillas,” renamed the Shandong Column in December. In August 1942 the column became the Shandong Military Region; in March 1943 that region merged with the 115th Division to form the new Shandong Military Region. This is a formation event and no march route is drawn.

Dates, appointments, and force size follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Fifth Plenary Session of the Kuomintang

summary.zh: 国民党五届五中全会确定防共、限共方针，同时坚持抗战。
summary.en: The Kuomintang’s fifth plenary session adopted a policy of guarding against and limiting the Communists while continuing the war.

description.zh:
1939 年 1 月，国民党五届五中全会在重庆召开，确定“溶共、防共、限共、反共”方针，设立防共委员会；同时仍表示坚持抗战。此后国共摩擦加剧，直至 1941 年皖南事变。

日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In January 1939 the Kuomintang’s fifth plenary session met in Chongqing and adopted a policy of “absorbing, guarding against, limiting, and opposing the Communists,” setting up an anti-Communist committee while still professing to continue the war. Kuomintang–Communist friction intensified, culminating in the Wannan Incident of 1941.

Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.en: The 120th Division Moves into Central Hebei

summary.zh: 贺龙、关向应率第120师主力到达冀中，与冀中军区会合。
summary.en: He Long and Guan Xiangying led the main force of the 120th Division into central Hebei and joined the Jizhong Military Region.

description.zh:
1938 年 12 月，八路军第120师主力在师长贺龙、政治委员关向应率领下由晋西北岚县出发，越过同蒲、平汉铁路封锁线，于 1939 年 1 月 25 日到达河北河间惠伯口，与冀中军区领导机关会合。随后成立冀中区总指挥部，贺龙任总指挥，统一指挥第120师和冀中军区部队，巩固冀中平原根据地。

行军日期与路线为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
In December 1938 the main force of the 120th Division, under commander He Long and political commissar Guan Xiangying, set out from Lanxian in northwestern Shanxi, crossed the Tongpu and Pinghan railway blockade lines, and on 25 January 1939 reached Huibokou, Hejian, Hebei, joining the Jizhong Military Region headquarters. A Jizhong unified command was then formed under He Long to direct the 120th Division and local forces in consolidating the central Hebei plain base area.

March dates and routes follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: The 115th Division’s Main Force Enters Shandong

summary.zh: 陈光、罗荣桓率第115师师部及第686团由晋西挺进山东，首战樊坝。
summary.en: Chen Guang and Luo Ronghuan led the 115th Division headquarters and 686th Regiment from western Shanxi into Shandong, winning their first battle at Fanba.

description.zh:
1938 年 12 月 2 日，八路军总部命令第115师主力挺进山东。12 月 20 日，代师长陈光、政治委员罗荣桓率师部、师直属队和第343旅第686团组成东进支队，由晋西灵石出发，1939 年元旦到达晋东南黎城、屯留一带整训。2 月中旬继续东进，经河北涉县、磁县和河南林县、鹤壁、濮阳，3 月 1 日越过黄河进入山东鄄城，随后在郓城西北樊坝首战告捷，歼灭伪军 500 余人。师部留第686团第三营等在鲁西开辟根据地，主力继续东进，9 月进入鲁南抱犊崮山区。第115师入鲁后与山东纵队并肩作战，1943 年 3 月两部合并为新的山东军区。

进入山东的日期各书记为 3 月 1 日或 2 日，樊坝战斗为 3 月 3 日晚至 4 日，此处取 3 月 1 日至 4 日；待页码级核对。
description.en:
On 2 December 1938 the Eighth Route Army headquarters ordered the 115th Division’s main force into Shandong. On 20 December acting commander Chen Guang and political commissar Luo Ronghuan formed the Eastern Advance Detachment from the division headquarters, its direct units, and the 686th Regiment of the 343rd Brigade, setting out from Lingshi in western Shanxi and reaching Licheng and Tunliu in southeastern Shanxi for training on New Year’s Day 1939. In mid-February it moved east through Shexian and Cixian in Hebei and Linxian, Hebi, and Puyang in Henan, crossed the Yellow River into Juancheng, Shandong, on 1 March, and won its first battle at Fanba northwest of Yuncheng, annihilating more than 500 puppet troops. The headquarters left the 686th Regiment’s 3rd Battalion and other units to open the western Shandong base while the main force continued east and entered the Baodugu mountains of southern Shandong in September. The 115th Division fought alongside the Shandong Column, and in March 1943 the two merged into the new Shandong Military Region.

Accounts give 1 or 2 March for the entry into Shandong and 3–4 March for the Fanba battle; this entry uses 1–4 March pending page-level verification.

summary.zh: 国民政府发起国民精神总动员，强调“国家至上、民族至上”。
summary.en: The Nationalist government launched the National Spiritual Mobilization, stressing “the nation above all, the people above all.”

description.zh:
1939 年 3 月，国民政府在重庆发起国民精神总动员，公布《国民精神总动员纲领》，以“国家至上、民族至上”动员抗战意志，推行节约、献金、慰问伤兵等活动。

日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In March 1939 the Nationalist government launched the National Spiritual Mobilization in Chongqing and published its program, calling for “the nation above all, the people above all” to sustain the will to resist. It promoted austerity, donations, and support for wounded soldiers.

Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.en: 74th Army in the Battle of Nanchang

summary.zh: 第74军在赣北高安、官桥、泗溪一线参加南昌会战，反攻南昌。
summary.en: The 74th Army fought in the Nanchang campaign along the Gao’an, Guanqiao, and Sixi line in northern Jiangxi.

description.zh:
1939 年 3 至 5 月南昌会战期间，第74军在赣北高安、官桥、泗溪一线抗击日军第34师团等部，并于 4 月参加反攻南昌。第74军是赣北战场表现最突出的部队之一。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
During the Battle of Nanchang from March to May 1939, the 74th Army fought the Japanese 34th Division and other units along the Gao’an, Guanqiao, and Sixi line in northern Jiangxi, and joined the counterattack on Nanchang in April. It was one of the best-performing Chinese units in the northern Jiangxi theater.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 第120师在齐会歼灭日军吉田大队大部，取得平原歼灭战胜利。
summary.en: The 120th Division destroyed most of the Japanese Yoshida Battalion at Qihui, a model annihilation battle on the plains.

description.zh:
1939 年 4 月 23 日至 25 日，八路军第120师在河北河间齐会地区围歼日军第27师团第3联队吉田大队 800 余人，毙伤日军 700 余人。日军施放毒气，贺龙等 20 余人中毒；白求恩率医疗队在前线连续工作 69 小时，实施手术 115 例。此战是八路军在平原地区首次大量歼敌的范例。

战果数字为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
From 23 to 25 April 1939 the 120th Division encircled and destroyed most of the Yoshida Battalion of the Japanese 27th Division’s 3rd Regiment at Qihui, Hejian, Hebei, inflicting more than 700 casualties on a force of over 800. Japanese troops used poison gas, poisoning He Long and more than 20 headquarters staff; Norman Bethune’s medical team worked 69 consecutive hours at the front and performed 115 operations. It was a model of large-scale annihilation warfare on the plains.

Casualty figures follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军进攻随县、枣阳地区，中国军队逐次抵抗并反击，恢复原阵地。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked the Suixian and Zaoyang areas; Chinese troops resisted in stages, counterattacked, and restored the original line.

description.zh:
1939 年 5 月，日军第 11 军向随县、枣阳地区进攻，企图打击中国第五战区主力。中国军队依托地形逐次抵抗，并在日军补给困难时反击，至 5 月下旬恢复原阵地。此役是抗战进入相持阶段后的重要作战。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In May 1939, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Suixian and Zaoyang areas, seeking to strike the main forces of China’s Fifth War Zone. Chinese troops used the terrain to resist in stages and counterattacked as Japanese supply lines became strained, restoring the original line by late May. It was an important operation after the war entered the stalemate phase.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

description.zh:
1939 年 7 月，王耀武接任第74军军长，部队驻防赣北高安。此后第74军参加第一次长沙会战、1939 年冬季攻势与上高会战，长期活跃于赣北、湘北之间。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In July 1939 Wang Yaowu took command of the 74th Army, which was stationed at Gao’an in northern Jiangxi. It then fought in the first Battle of Changsha, the winter offensive of 1939, and the Shanggao campaign, remaining active between northern Jiangxi and northern Hunan.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 日军进攻长沙，中国军队在新墙河、汨罗江一线阻击并反击，恢复原阵地。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Changsha; Chinese troops blocked and counterattacked along the Xinqiang and Miluo rivers, restoring their original positions.

description.zh:
1939 年 9 月 14 日，日军集中兵力向湖南新墙河一线发起进攻，企图攻取长沙。中国军队第九战区部队逐次阻击，诱敌深入后侧击、反击，迫使日军于 10 月上旬退回原阵地。此役是抗战进入相持阶段后中国正面战场的一次重要防御作战。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 14 September 1939, Japanese forces launched an offensive across the Xinqiang River in Hunan in an attempt to take Changsha. Chinese troops of the Ninth War Zone resisted in stages, drew the Japanese forward, then struck their flanks and counterattacked, forcing a withdrawal to the original line in early October. It was an important defensive battle on China’s frontal battlefield during the stalemate phase.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

description.en: On September 14, 1939, Japanese forces attacked the Xinqiang River line in Hunan, beginning the first Battle of Changsha. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Jin-Cha-Ji troops killed Major General Abe Norihide, commander of the Japanese 2nd Independent Mixed Brigade, at Huangtuling.

description.zh:
1939 年 11 月，日军独立混成第2旅团对晋察冀根据地进行“扫荡”。11 月 7 日，晋察冀军区第一军分区等部在河北涞源黄土岭设伏，击毙旅团长阿部规秀中将，歼敌数百人。阿部规秀是抗战期间被八路军击毙的日军最高级别将领之一。

日期、兵力与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
In November 1939 the Japanese 2nd Independent Mixed Brigade conducted a “mopping-up” operation against the Jin-Cha-Ji base area. On 7 November troops of the Jin-Cha-Ji Military Region’s 1st Sub-district ambushed the column at Huangtuling, Laiyuan, Hebei, killing brigade commander Major General Abe Norihide and several hundred soldiers. Abe was one of the most senior Japanese officers killed by the Eighth Route Army during the war.

Dates, force sizes, and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Chinese forces counterattacked at Kunlun Pass and recaptured the strategic pass after fierce fighting.

description.zh:
1939 年 12 月，中国军队为收复南宁、夺回昆仑关，对日军发起反攻。中国第 5 军等部在昆仑关与日军激战，反复争夺，最终于 1940 年 1 月收复昆仑关，击毙日军旅团长中村正雄。此役是抗战中期中国军队的一次重要攻坚胜利。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In December 1939, Chinese forces launched a counteroffensive to recover Nanning and retake Kunlun Pass. The Chinese 5th Army and other units fought fierce, seesaw battles against the Japanese at the pass, finally recapturing it in January 1940 and killing the Japanese brigade commander Nakamura Masao. It was an important Chinese offensive victory in the middle years of the war.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

description.zh: 1939 年 12 月日军第 18 师团等自广州北犯，第一次粤北会战爆发；中国军队逐次抵抗并反攻，日军攻至韶关外围后于 1940 年 1 月中旬撤回广州。韶关为战时广东省会，始终未陷。
description.en: In December 1939 the Japanese 18th Division and others moved north from Guangzhou, opening the first northern Guangdong battle; the Chinese army resisted and counter-attacked, and the Japanese, having reached the outskirts of Shaoguan, withdrew to Guangzhou in mid-January 1940. Shaoguan, the wartime provincial capital, never fell.

summary.zh: 日军进攻宾阳，企图迂回昆仑关后路。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Binyang, attempting to outflank Kunlun Pass.

description.en: In January 1940, Japanese forces attacked Binyang, Guangxi, attempting to outflank Kunlun Pass. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: After Kunlun Pass the 5th Army moved from Guangxi to Yunnan for training and later became the core of the Expeditionary Force.

description.zh:
1940 年初昆仑关战役结束后，第5军经南宁、百色移驻云南昆明、杨林一带整训。1942 年 2 月，第5军作为中国远征军先头部队自云南入缅。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
After the Battle of Kunlun Pass in early 1940, the 5th Army moved via Nanning and Bose to Kunming and Yanglin in Yunnan for training. In February 1942 it entered Burma as the spearhead of the Chinese Expeditionary Force.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 汪精卫在南京成立伪国民政府，重庆国民政府发布讨伐令。
summary.en: Wang Jingwei set up a puppet government in Nanjing, and the Chongqing government issued an order condemning him.

description.zh:
1940 年 3 月 30 日，汪精卫在日本扶植下于南京成立伪国民政府。重庆国民政府发布讨伐令，宣布汪伪政权无效，并通缉汪精卫。

日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 30 March 1940 Wang Jingwei, backed by Japan, established a puppet National Government in Nanjing. The Chongqing government issued an order condemning the regime as illegitimate and offering a reward for Wang’s arrest.

Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 第33集团军参加枣宜会战，总司令张自忠殉国。
summary.en: The 33rd Group Army fought in the Zaoyi campaign; its commander Zhang Zizhong was killed.

description.zh: 1940 年 5 月，第33集团军（总司令张自忠）参加枣宜会战，张自忠于 5 月 16 日在宜城附近殉国。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In May 1940, the 33rd Group Army under Zhang Zizhong fought in the Zaoyi campaign; Zhang was killed near Yicheng on May 16. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《中华民国史》
sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 日军进攻枣阳、宜昌地区，中国军队顽强抵抗，张自忠殉国，宜昌最终失守。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked the Zaoyang and Yichang areas; Chinese troops resisted stubbornly, Zhang Zizhong was killed, and Yichang eventually fell.

description.zh:
1940 年 5 月，日军第十一军向枣阳、襄阳、宜昌地区发动进攻，企图歼灭中国第五战区主力并控制长江上游门户。中国军队在枣阳、襄阳一线抵抗，第 33 集团军总司令张自忠在宜城南瓜店战斗中殉国。6 月，宜昌失守。此役中国军队伤亡重大，但保持了战区主力。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In May 1940, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Zaoyang, Xiangyang, and Yichang areas, seeking to destroy the main forces of China’s Fifth War Zone and control the upper Yangtze gateway. Chinese troops resisted along the Zaoyang–Xiangyang line, and Zhang Zizhong, commander of the 33rd Army Group, was killed in action near Nanguadian in Yicheng. Yichang fell in June. Chinese forces suffered heavy casualties but preserved the bulk of the war zone’s strength.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.zh: 第33集团军总司令张自忠在枣宜会战中于南瓜店殉国。
summary.en: General Zhang Zizhong, commander of the 33rd Group Army, died at Nanguadian during the Zaoyang–Yichang campaign.

description.zh:
1940 年 5 月，枣宜会战期间，第33集团军总司令张自忠率部渡襄河督战，5 月 16 日在宜城南瓜店被日军包围，力战殉国，是抗战中阵亡的最高级别中国将领之一。

人物事件，随第33集团军路线标注；日期与地点待史料校订。
description.en:
In May 1940, during the Zaoyang–Yichang campaign, General Zhang Zizhong, commander of the 33rd Group Army, crossed the Xiang River to direct operations. On 16 May he was surrounded by Japanese forces at Nanguadian in Yicheng and died fighting, one of the most senior Chinese commanders killed in the war.

A biographical event marked with the 33rd Group Army route; dates and location await historical review.

place.zh: 华北正太铁路沿线（阳泉一带）
place.en: Along the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway in North China (Yangquan area)

summary.zh: 八路军在华北发动大规模破袭战，先后参战部队达一百余个团。
summary.en: The Eighth Route Army launched a large-scale sabotage campaign in North China involving more than a hundred regiments.

description.zh:
1940 年 8 月 20 日起，八路军在副总司令彭德怀、副参谋长左权指挥下，在华北发动以破袭正太铁路为重点的大规模进攻，先后参战部队达 105 个团，故称“百团大战”。战役分破袭交通线、攻取据点、反“扫荡”三个阶段，持续至 1941 年初，对日军交通线和据点造成较大打击，也促使日军加强对华北敌后根据地的“扫荡”。

参战团数、阶段划分与战果各书记载不一，待页码级核对。
description.en:
From 20 August 1940, under deputy commander Peng Dehuai and deputy chief of staff Zuo Quan, the Eighth Route Army launched a large offensive in North China centered on sabotaging the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway. Eventually 105 regiments took part, hence the name “Hundred Regiments Offensive.” The campaign had three phases—cutting transport lines, attacking strongpoints, and countering Japanese “mopping-up” operations—and lasted into early 1941, damaging Japanese communications and prompting harsher operations against base areas.

Regiment counts, phase divisions, and results vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

sources.title: 《中国人民解放军战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

name.en: Sabotage of the western Zhengding–Taiyuan railway

summary.zh: 百团大战第一阶段，第129师破袭正太铁路西段。
summary.en: In the first phase of the Hundred Regiments Offensive, the 129th Division sabotaged the western section of the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway.

description.zh:
1940 年 8 月 20 日夜，百团大战第一阶段开始，八路军第129师以第385旅、第386旅、新编第10旅等部破袭正太铁路西段，重点破坏阳泉至榆次间的铁路、桥梁、隧道和车站，并攻取沿线部分据点。

参战番号与破袭范围各书记载略有出入，待页码级核对。
description.en:
On the night of 20 August 1940 the first phase of the Hundred Regiments Offensive began. The 129th Division, with the 385th, 386th, and new 10th brigades, sabotaged the western section of the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway, concentrating on track, bridges, tunnels, and stations between Yangquan and Yuci and capturing some strongpoints along the line.

Participating units and the extent of sabotage vary slightly between accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The Guangdong People’s Anti-Japanese Guerrillas established a base area around Bao’an and Huiyang.

description.zh: 1940 年 9 月，广东人民抗日游击队第五大队在宝安、惠阳一带建立东江抗日根据地。时间与范围为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In September 1940, the 5th Detachment of the Guangdong People’s Anti-Japanese Guerrillas established the Dongjiang base area around Bao’an and Huiyang. Dates and extent follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军入侵越南北部后，滇军第60军由赣北调回云南，防守滇越边境。
summary.en: After Japan moved into northern Vietnam, the Yunnan 60th Army was transferred from northern Jiangxi back to Yunnan to guard the Sino-Vietnamese border.

description.zh:
1940 年 9 月，日军入侵越南北部，威胁滇南。第60军第182、184师由赣北靖安、安义一线调回云南，防守滇越边境。此后第60军长期驻守滇南，直至抗战胜利。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In September 1940 Japan moved into northern Vietnam and threatened southern Yunnan. The 60th Army’s 182nd and 184th Divisions were transferred from Jing’an and Anyi in northern Jiangxi back to Yunnan to guard the Sino-Vietnamese border. The army then held southern Yunnan until the end of the war.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 国民政府明定重庆为陪都。
summary.en: The Nationalist government formally designated Chongqing as the wartime capital.

description.zh:
1940 年 9 月 6 日，国民政府明定重庆为陪都，确立其战时政治中心地位。重庆同时是大后方工业、教育与外交活动的中心。

日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 6 September 1940 the Nationalist government formally designated Chongqing as the wartime capital, confirming its role as the political center. It was also the hub of rear-area industry, education, and diplomacy.

Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

description.zh: 1940 年 10 月，东江抗日游击队在大岭山一带建立抗日根据地。时间与范围为通行说法，待页码级核对。

summary.zh: 第60军进驻蒙自、河口一线，防守滇越边境，直至抗战胜利。
summary.en: The 60th Army held the Mengzi–Hekou line on the Sino-Vietnamese border until the end of the war.

description.zh:
1940 年 10 月起，第60军进驻蒙自、河口一线，依托滇越铁路与红河防线阻止日军由越南侵入云南。滇南防御持续五年，直至 1945 年抗战胜利。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
From October 1940 the 60th Army held the Mengzi–Hekou line, using the Yunnan–Vietnam railway and the Red River defenses to block a Japanese advance from Vietnam into Yunnan. The defense of southern Yunnan lasted five years until the Japanese surrender in 1945.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 新四军在黄桥反击国民党军，打开苏北局面。
summary.en: The New Fourth Army counterattacked KMT forces at Huangqiao, opening up northern Jiangsu.

description.zh:
1940 年 10 月，新四军苏北指挥部在江苏泰兴黄桥地区反击国民党军韩德勤部，取得黄桥战役胜利。日期与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。

本事件为战役点，不绘行军路线：黄桥战役由新四军苏北指挥部率部自苏南渡江发起，与军部驻地云岭不是同一条路线。
description.en:
In October 1940, the New Fourth Army’s Northern Jiangsu Command counterattacked KMT forces under Han Deqin at Huangqiao, Taixing, Jiangsu, winning the Battle of Huangqiao. Dates and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

This is a battle point with no march route: the Battle of Huangqiao was fought by the N4A Northern Jiangsu Command moving north from southern Jiangsu, not by the headquarters at Yunling.

sources.title: 《中国人民解放军战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

summary.zh: 百团大战第三阶段，八路军围攻日军冈崎支队，未能全歼。
summary.en: In the third phase of the Hundred Regiments Offensive, the Eighth Route Army besieged the Japanese Okazaki Detachment but failed to destroy it.

description.zh:
1940 年 10 月 30 日至 11 月 1 日，八路军第129师第385旅、第386旅、新编第10旅及决死第1纵队等部在山西武乡关家垴围攻日军第36师团冈崎支队约 500 人。日军依托窑洞和山地工事顽抗，八路军多次攻击未果，自身伤亡较大，最终日军援兵赶到，残部撤走。此战是百团大战第三阶段反“扫荡”中的一场硬仗，也暴露了八路军攻坚能力的不足。

兵力与伤亡数字各书记载不一，待页码级核对。
description.en:
From 30 October to 1 November 1940 the 129th Division—with the 385th, 386th, and new 10th brigades and the 1st Suicide Squad—besieged about 500 men of the Japanese 36th Division’s Okazaki Detachment at Guanjianao, Wuxiang, Shanxi. The Japanese held out in cave dwellings and hill fortifications; repeated assaults failed and the attackers suffered heavy casualties before Japanese reinforcements arrived and the remnants withdrew. The battle was a hard fight in the third phase of the Hundred Regiments Offensive and exposed the Eighth Route Army’s limited capability in attacking fortified positions.

Force and casualty figures vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

description.en: In December 1940, the Qiongya Anti-Japanese Independent Corps was attacked by KMT forces at Meihe, Chengmai, Hainan, an event known as the Meihe Incident. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

description.zh: 1941 年 1 月，新四军军部及所属皖南部队在安徽泾县茂林地区遭国民党军围攻，损失惨重，史称皖南事变。日期与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In January 1941, the New Fourth Army headquarters and its Southern Anhui units were encircled by KMT forces in the Maolin area of Jing County, Anhui, suffering heavy losses; this became known as the Wannan Incident. Dates and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 第21集团军第84军在息县方向参加豫南会战。

summary.zh: 1941 年 2 月，琼崖抗日根据地在琼山、文昌一带坚持斗争；五指山根据地于 1943—1944 年开辟。
summary.en: In February 1941 the Qiongya base area held out around Qiongshan and Wenchang; the Wuzhishan base was opened in 1943–1944.

description.zh:
1941 年 2 月，美合事变后琼崖特委和独立总队返回琼山、文昌一带，继续坚持抗日斗争。五指山根据地则于 1943—1944 年逐步开辟。时间与范围为通行说法，待页码级核对。

本事件为根据地形成，不绘路线；五指山方向的进军见 1944 年「琼崖纵队挺进五指山」。
description.en:
In February 1941, after the Meihe Incident, the Qiongya Special Committee and the Independent Corps returned to the Qiongshan–Wenchang area and continued resistance. The Wuzhishan base was opened only in 1943–1944. Dates and extent follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

No route is drawn for this base-area event; the 1944 advance into Wuzhishan is covered separately.

summary.en: In the southern Henan battle the Japanese reached Wuyang and withdrew to Xinyang.

description.zh: 1941 年 1 月 25 日日军第 11 军自信阳北犯，豫南会战爆发；日军攻至舞阳、方城一带，中国军队避免决战、侧击其后，日军于 2 月 11 日撤回信阳。
description.en: On 25 January 1941 the Japanese 11th Army moved north from Xinyang, opening the southern Henan battle; it reached Wuyang and Fangcheng, but the Chinese army avoided a decisive battle and struck its rear, so the Japanese withdrew to Xinyang on 11 February.

1941 年 3 月 11 日，美国签署《租借法案》，随后将中国纳入援助范围，提供武器、物资与贷款，支持中国继续抗战。

日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 11 March 1941 the United States signed the Lend-Lease Act and soon extended aid to China, providing weapons, supplies, and credits to support continued resistance.

Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 日军进攻上高，中国军队包围反击，取得上高大捷。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Shanggao; Chinese troops encircled and counterattacked, winning a major victory.

description.zh:
1941 年 3 月，日军第十一军向江西上高地区进攻，企图打击中国第九战区部队。中国军队依托地形逐次抵抗，诱敌深入后实施包围反击，至 4 月上旬收复失地，取得上高会战胜利。此役是抗战中期正面战场的一次重要胜利。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In March 1941, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Shanggao area of Jiangxi, seeking to strike Chinese forces of the Ninth War Zone. Chinese troops resisted in stages using the terrain, drew the Japanese in, then counterattacked and encircled them, recovering the lost ground by early April and winning the Battle of Shanggao. It was an important victory on China’s frontal battlefield in the middle years of the war.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

1941 年 3 月 19 日，中国民主政团同盟在重庆秘密成立，10 月 10 日公开，主张团结抗战、实行民主，成为战时重要的中间党派联合组织。

日期与表述取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 19 March 1941 the Chinese Democratic League was secretly founded in Chongqing and made public on 10 October. It called for united resistance and democratic government and became an important wartime coalition of middle parties.

Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: At the end of the Shanggao battle the Japanese withdrew to Nanchang and the Chinese recovered Shanggao and Gao’an.

description.zh: 1941 年 3 月 15 日日军自南昌进攻上高，中国军队第 74 军等部诱敌深入、两翼反击，日军伤亡惨重，4 月 9 日退回南昌，中国军队收复上高、高安、奉新。
description.en: On 15 March 1941 the Japanese attacked Shanggao from Nanchang; the Chinese 74th Corps and others drew them in and counter-attacked on both flanks, inflicting heavy losses; the Japanese withdrew to Nanchang on 9 April and the Chinese recovered Shanggao, Gao’an and Fengxin.

summary.zh: 日军围攻中条山中国守军，中国军队遭受重大损失，被迫南渡黄河突围。
summary.en: Japanese forces besieged Chinese troops in the Zhongtiao Mountains; the Chinese army suffered heavy losses and was forced to break out south across the Yellow River.

description.zh:
1941 年 5 月，日军集中兵力围攻山西南部中条山地区的中国军队。中国守军补给困难、指挥协同不足，在日军多路进攻下遭受重大损失，部分部队南渡黄河突围。此役是抗战中期中国正面战场的一次严重失利。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In May 1941, Japanese forces concentrated their strength to besiege Chinese troops in the Zhongtiao Mountains of southern Shanxi. Hampered by supply difficulties and poor coordination, the Chinese defenders suffered heavy losses under multiple Japanese attacks, and part of the force broke out south across the Yellow River. It was a serious setback for China’s frontal battlefield in the middle years of the war.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

description.en:
On 1 August 1941 the American Volunteer Group was formed in Kunming under Claire Chennault. Known as the “Flying Tigers,” it fought in the Burma theater and in the defense of Chinese airspace.

Dates and wording follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 日军再次进攻长沙，中国军队逐次抵抗并反击，日军于 10 月上旬退回原阵地。
summary.en: Japanese forces again attacked Changsha; Chinese troops resisted in stages and counterattacked, forcing a Japanese withdrawal to the original line in early October.

description.zh:
1941 年 9 月，日军第十一军向新墙河、汨罗江一线发起进攻，企图击破中国第九战区主力并攻取长沙。中国军队逐次抵抗，双方在长沙外围激战；日军因补给困难和中国军队侧击，于 10 月上旬退回原阵地。此役双方均有较大伤亡。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In September 1941, the Japanese 11th Army attacked across the Xinqiang and Miluo rivers, aiming to destroy the main forces of China’s Ninth War Zone and take Changsha. Chinese troops resisted in stages and fought fierce actions on the city’s outskirts. Hampered by supply difficulties and Chinese flank attacks, the Japanese withdrew to their original line in early October. Both sides suffered considerable casualties.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.zh: 晋察冀军区一团七连六班掩护机关和群众转移，弹尽后跳崖。
summary.en: The 6th Squad of the 7th Company, 1st Regiment, covered the evacuation of headquarters and civilians and jumped from the cliff after running out of ammunition.

description.zh:
1941 年 9 月 25 日，日军“扫荡”晋察冀边区，晋察冀军区第1军分区第1团第7连第6班班长马宝玉、副班长葛振林和战士宋学义、胡德林、胡福才，为掩护党政机关和群众转移，将日军引向易县狼牙山棋盘陀绝顶，弹尽粮绝后毁枪跳崖。马宝玉、胡德林、胡福才牺牲，葛振林、宋学义被树枝挂住负伤获救。

战斗细节与歼敌数字各书记载不一，待页码级核对。
description.en:
On 25 September 1941, during a Japanese “mopping-up” campaign in the Jin-Cha-Ji border region, the 6th Squad of the 7th Company, 1st Regiment, 1st Sub-district—squad leader Ma Baoyu, deputy leader Ge Zhenlin, and soldiers Song Xueyi, Hu Delin, and Hu Fucai—drew Japanese troops toward the summit of Qipantuo on Langya Mountain, Yi County, to cover the evacuation of party and government organs and civilians. After running out of ammunition they destroyed their rifles and jumped from the cliff. Ma Baoyu, Hu Delin, and Hu Fucai died; Ge Zhenlin and Song Xueyi were caught by branches and survived with injuries.

Details and enemy casualty figures vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: The headquarters guard regiment defended the Huangyadong arsenal in several days of fighting.

description.zh:
1941 年 11 月，八路军总部特务团在山西黎城黄崖洞与日军激战数日，保卫总部兵工厂。黄崖洞是八路军在敌后最大的兵工厂所在地，此战以少敌多，掩护了兵工厂设备和人员转移。

日期、参战兵力与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
In November 1941 the Eighth Route Army headquarters guard regiment fought Japanese forces for several days at Huangyadong, Licheng, Shanxi, defending the headquarters arsenal. Huangyadong housed the Eighth Route Army’s largest arsenal behind enemy lines; the outnumbered defenders covered the evacuation of equipment and personnel.

Dates, force sizes, and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日本海军偷袭珍珠港，太平洋战争爆发，中国抗战与世界大战连为一体。
summary.en: The Japanese navy attacked Pearl Harbor, starting the Pacific War and linking China’s resistance to the global conflict.

description.zh:
1941 年 12 月 7 日（夏威夷时间），日本海军袭击美国太平洋舰队基地珍珠港。美国随即对日宣战，太平洋战争爆发。中国战场成为世界反法西斯战争的重要组成部分。

本事件为国际事件，不绘制路线；日期按夏威夷时间标注，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 7 December 1941 (Hawaii time), the Japanese navy attacked the US Pacific Fleet base at Pearl Harbor. The United States declared war on Japan, and the Pacific War began. The China theater became an important part of the global anti-fascist war.

This is an international event with no route drawn; the date follows Hawaii time and awaits historical review.

summary.zh: 太平洋战争爆发后，中国政府正式对日本、德国、意大利宣战。
summary.en: After the Pacific War began, the Chinese government formally declared war on Japan, Germany, and Italy.

description.zh:
1941 年 12 月 9 日，中国国民政府对日本、德国、意大利正式宣战，并宣布与三国所订一切条约、协定、合同一律废止。中国抗战由此更紧密地融入世界反法西斯同盟。

本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
On 9 December 1941, the Chinese National Government formally declared war on Japan, Germany, and Italy and annulled all treaties, agreements, and contracts with them. China’s resistance became more closely integrated into the global anti-fascist alliance.

This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

sources.author: 中国社会科学院近代史研究所

summary.zh: 日军第三次进攻长沙，中国军队以“天炉战法”诱敌深入并反击，取得长沙大捷。
summary.en: Japan attacked Changsha for the third time; Chinese forces drew the Japanese in and counterattacked, winning a major victory.

description.zh:
1941 年 12 月 24 日，日军第十一军再次向长沙进攻。中国第九战区司令长官薛岳采取“天炉战法”，以一部兵力逐次抵抗、诱敌深入，主力从外围侧击、合围。日军攻入长沙外围后补给困难，被迫撤退；中国军队追击，至 1942 年 1 月中旬恢复原阵地。此役是太平洋战争爆发后中国正面战场的一次重要胜利。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 24 December 1941, the Japanese 11th Army attacked Changsha again. Xue Yue, commander of China’s Ninth War Zone, employed the “heavenly furnace” tactic: a covering force resisted in stages and drew the Japanese inward while the main force struck the flanks and closed the ring. After reaching the outskirts of Changsha, the Japanese faced supply difficulties and were forced to retreat. Chinese forces pursued and restored the original line by mid-January 1942. It was an important victory on China’s frontal battlefield after the outbreak of the Pacific War.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.en: The Chinese Expeditionary Force entered Burma from Yunnan to help defend the Burma Road alongside Allied forces.

description.zh:
1942 年初，为保卫滇缅公路和支援盟军，中国远征军陆续自云南入缅，与英军协同作战。远征军在缅北、缅中地区与日军激战，后因战局不利而撤退。

本事件日期取 1942 年 2 月的示意时间点，具体入缅日期待史料校订。
description.en:
In early 1942, to defend the Burma Road and support the Allies, the Chinese Expeditionary Force entered Burma from Yunnan and fought alongside British troops. It engaged Japanese forces in northern and central Burma before withdrawing under unfavorable conditions.

The date is an illustrative point in February 1942; the exact entry dates await historical review.

description.zh:
1942 年 3 月，第5军先头部队第200师自云南经保山、畹町进入缅甸，抵达同古接替英军防务，随后与日军展开同古保卫战。

In March 1942 the 5th Army’s 200th Division entered Burma from Yunnan via Baoshan and Wanding and reached Toungoo, where it took over from British troops and fought the defense of Toungoo.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 琼崖抗日武装在海南展开反“扫荡”作战。
summary.en: Qiongya anti-Japanese forces fought counter-mopping operations in Hainan.

description.zh: 1942 年 5 月起，日军对琼崖抗日根据地发动“扫荡”，琼崖独立总队展开反“扫荡”作战。时间与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: From May 1942, Japanese forces launched mopping-up operations against the Qiongya anti-Japanese base area, and the Qiongya Independent Corps fought back. Dates and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

description.en: In January 1942 the Japanese 15th Army invaded Burma from Thailand, took Rangoon on 8 March and Mandalay on 1 May; the Chinese expeditionary force and British withdrew to India and Yunnan, ending the campaign.

sources.title: 缅甸战役
sources.author: 日本防卫厅防卫研修所战史室

name.en: Counter-Offensive against the May Day “Mopping-Up” in Central Hebei

place.zh: 河北冀中（河间、饶阳一带）

summary.zh: 日军 5 万余人“拉网扫荡”冀中，冀中军民艰苦反“扫荡”。
summary.en: More than 50,000 Japanese troops conducted a dragnet “mopping-up” of central Hebei; local forces and civilians fought a costly counter-campaign.

description.zh:
1942 年 5 月 1 日起，日军华北方面军调集 5 万余人，对冀中抗日根据地发动“五一大扫荡”，采取“铁壁合围”“拉网清剿”战法。冀中军区部队和民兵在极端困难条件下分散游击、坚持反“扫荡”，但根据地大部被分割，部队和群众损失严重，冀中抗战进入最艰苦阶段。

兵力与损失数字各书记载不一，待页码级核对。
description.en:
From 1 May 1942 the Japanese North China Area Army committed more than 50,000 troops to a “May Day mopping-up” of the central Hebei base area, using “iron-wall encirclement” and dragnet search tactics. Jizhong Military Region troops and militia dispersed into guerrilla warfare and persevered, but most of the base area was cut up and military and civilian losses were severe; the resistance in central Hebei entered its hardest period.

Force and loss figures vary between accounts and await page-level verification.

name.zh: 日军自杭州发动浙赣作战
name.en: Japanese launch the Zhejiang–Jiangxi operation from Hangzhou

summary.zh: 日军第 13 军自杭州西进，与南昌日军东西对进。
summary.en: The Japanese 13th Army moved west from Hangzhou to meet the Nanchang force.

description.zh: 1942 年 5 月 15 日日军第 13 军自杭州、萧山出动，沿浙赣路西进；南昌方面的日军同时东进，两路在横峰会合，7 月日军撤退，浙赣会战结束。杭州自 1937 年 12 月即为日军占领。
description.en: On 15 May 1942 the Japanese 13th Army moved out of Hangzhou and Xiaoshan west along the Zhejiang–Jiangxi railway while the Nanchang force moved east; the columns met at Hengfeng, and the Japanese withdrew in July, ending the campaign. Hangzhou had been occupied since December 1937.

summary.zh: 八路军总部在十字岭突围，副参谋长左权牺牲。
summary.en: The Eighth Route Army headquarters broke out at Shiziling; deputy chief of staff Zuo Quan was killed.

description.zh:
1942 年 5 月，日军对太行根据地进行“扫荡”。5 月 25 日，八路军总部和中共中央北方局机关在山西辽县十字岭一带遭日军合围，副参谋长左权在指挥突围时牺牲，年仅 37 岁。

日期、地点与经过为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
In May 1942 Japanese forces conducted a “mopping-up” campaign in the Taihang base area. On 25 May the Eighth Route Army headquarters and the CCP Northern Bureau were encircled near Shiziling, Liaoxian, Shanxi; deputy chief of staff Zuo Quan was killed while directing the breakout at the age of 37.

Dates, location, and details follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 缅甸战败后，第5军第200师退回滇西，新编第22师退往印度。
summary.en: After the Burma defeat the 200th Division returned to western Yunnan while the New 22nd Division withdrew to India.

description.zh:
1942 年 5 月缅甸战局逆转，第5军被迫撤退。第200师经缅北退回云南保山一带，新编第22师随杜聿明部退往印度。撤退途中损失惨重。

路线为示意简化，仅画第200师回滇主线；新22师退印另见盟军线。日期待史料校订。
description.en:
In May 1942 the Burma front collapsed and the 5th Army was forced to retreat. The 200th Division returned to the Baoshan area of Yunnan, while the New 22nd Division withdrew to India with Du Yuming’s headquarters. Losses during the retreat were severe.

Illustrative simplified route showing only the 200th Division’s return; the New 22nd Division’s withdrawal to India is covered by the Allied layer. Dates await historical review.

summary.zh: 缅甸战局失利后，中国远征军部分部队撤往印度，后整编为中国驻印军。
summary.en: After setbacks in Burma, part of the Chinese Expeditionary Force withdrew to India and was later reorganized as the Chinese Army in India.

description.zh:
1942 年 5 月前后，缅甸战局恶化，中国远征军部分部队经野人山等路线撤往印度，损失惨重；另一部分退回云南。撤至印度的部队后来在兰姆伽整训，整编为中国驻印军。

本事件日期为示意时间点，撤退路线与时间待史料校订。
description.en:
Around May 1942, as the situation in Burma deteriorated, part of the Chinese Expeditionary Force withdrew to India through difficult routes including the Naga Hills, suffering heavy losses; another part returned to Yunnan. The troops in India were later reorganized and trained at Ramgarh as the Chinese Army in India.

The date is an illustrative point; retreat routes and timing await historical review.

sources.title: 《中国抗日战争史》
sources.author: 张宪文等
sources.note: 远征军撤退与整训参考

summary.zh: 缅甸战败后，第5军新22师经野人山退往印度雷多。
summary.en: After the Burma defeat the New 22nd Division of the 5th Army withdrew through the Naga Hills to Ledo, India.

description.zh:
1942 年 5 月缅甸战局逆转后，第5军新22师随杜聿明部经野人山向印度撤退，8 月抵达印度雷多（利多）。撤退途中损失惨重，后改编为中国驻印军。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
After the Burma front collapsed in May 1942, the New 22nd Division of the 5th Army withdrew with Du Yuming’s headquarters through the Naga Hills toward India and reached Ledo in August. Losses during the retreat were severe; the division was later reorganized into the Chinese Army in India.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

description.zh: 1943 年 4 月，中国远征军司令长官部在云南楚雄成立，陈诚任司令长官，后由卫立煌接任。日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en: In April 1943, the Chinese Expeditionary Force headquarters was established at Chuxiong, Yunnan, with Chen Cheng as commander and later Wei Lihuang. Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 第18军调防宜昌石牌，第11师随后参加石牌保卫战。
summary.en: The 18th Army moved to Shipai near Yichang, and its 11th Division fought in the defense of Shipai.

description.zh:
1943 年春，第18军调防宜昌以西石牌要塞，第11师担任核心守备。5 月鄂西会战爆发，第11师在石牌与日军激战，守住三峡门户。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In spring 1943 the 18th Army moved to the Shipai fortress west of Yichang, with the 11th Division holding the core positions. When the Western Hubei campaign began in May, the 11th Division fought bitterly at Shipai and held the gateway to the Three Gorges.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

sources.title: 《中国人民解放军战史》
sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

summary.zh: 日军进攻鄂西，中国军队在石牌要塞一带顽强阻击，挫败日军攻势。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked western Hubei; Chinese troops stubbornly defended the Shipai fortress area and thwarted the offensive.

description.zh:
1943 年 5 月，日军第十一军向鄂西地区进攻，企图夺取石牌要塞、威胁重庆。中国第六战区部队依托长江三峡地形顽强抵抗，在石牌一带与日军激战，最终迫使日军撤退。此役是抗战后期正面战场的一次重要防御胜利。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In May 1943, the Japanese 11th Army attacked western Hubei, seeking to seize the Shipai fortress and threaten Chongqing. Chinese troops of the Sixth War Zone used the terrain of the Three Gorges to resist stubbornly, fighting fierce actions around Shipai and eventually forcing the Japanese to withdraw. It was an important defensive victory on China’s frontal battlefield in the later war years.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.en: The Japanese crossed south from Jingzhou and Shishou against western Hubei.

description.zh: 1943 年 5 月 5 日日军第 11 军自荆州、石首一带渡江南犯，鄂西会战爆发；中国军队在石牌、渔洋关一线阻击，6 月日军退回原防。荆州自 1940 年 6 月即为日军占领。
description.en: On 5 May 1943 the Japanese 11th Army crossed the Yangtze from the Jingzhou–Shishou area, opening the western Hubei battle; the Chinese army held at Shipai and Yuyangguan, and the Japanese withdrew in June. Jingzhou had been occupied since June 1940.

description.en: On 5 May 1943 the Japanese moved south from Jingzhou and Shishou into western Hubei; Chen Cheng’s 6th War Area moved troops from Enshi to hold the Shipai and Yuyangguan line, and the Japanese withdrew in June.

summary.zh: 第18军第11师在石牌要塞与日军激战，守住三峡门户。
summary.en: The 11th Division of the 18th Army held the Shipai fortress and the gateway to the Three Gorges.

description.zh:
1943 年 5 月鄂西会战中，第18军第11师（师长胡琏）守石牌要塞，与日军第3、第39师团激战，守住三峡门户。石牌保卫战被称为“东方的斯大林格勒”。

日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
In the Western Hubei campaign of May 1943 the 11th Division of the 18th Army under Hu Lian held the Shipai fortress against the Japanese 3rd and 39th Divisions, guarding the gateway to the Three Gorges. The defense of Shipai has been called “the Stalingrad of the East.”

Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

name.en: Start of the Northern Burma Counteroffensive

summary.zh: 中国驻印军与盟军自印度利多出发，向缅北日军发起反攻。
summary.en: Chinese forces in India and Allied troops advanced from Ledo to counterattack Japanese forces in northern Burma.

description.zh:
1943 年 10 月起，中国驻印军新一军等部与美军部队自印度利多出发，向缅北推进，先后进行胡康河谷、孟拱河谷等战役，为打通中印公路创造条件。

本事件日期为示意时间点，作战经过待史料校订。
description.en:
Beginning in October 1943, the Chinese Army in India, including the New 1st Army, and US units advanced from Ledo into northern Burma, fighting in the Hukawng and Mogaung valleys and helping to open the Ledo Road.

The date is an illustrative point; operational details await historical review.

summary.zh: 第74军由长沙方向调防常德，随后参加常德会战。
summary.en: The 74th Army moved from the Changsha area to Changde and fought in the Battle of Changde.

description.zh:
1943 年秋，第74军由长沙方向调防常德，第57师守常德城，军主力在外围策应。11 月常德会战爆发，第57师苦守孤城，第74军等部在外围反攻。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In autumn 1943 the 74th Army moved from the Changsha area to Changde; the 57th Division held the city while the main force operated on the outskirts. When the Battle of Changde began in November, the 57th Division held out in the isolated city and the 74th Army counterattacked from outside.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 第129师386旅16团在韩略村伏击日军战地观战团，歼敌 120 余人。
summary.en: The 16th Regiment of the 386th Brigade ambushed a Japanese officers’ observation group at Hanluecun, killing more than 120.

description.zh:
1943 年 10 月 24 日，八路军第129师第386旅第16团在团长王近山率领下，于山西洪洞韩略村西侧公路伏击日军华北方面军组织的战地观战团，歼灭少将旅团长以下军官 120 余人，击毁汽车 13 辆。此战打乱了日军对太岳根据地的“扫荡”部署。

歼敌数字与番号细节各书记载略有出入，待页码级核对。
description.en:
On 24 October 1943 the 16th Regiment of the 386th Brigade, 129th Division, under commander Wang Jinshan, ambushed a Japanese officers’ battlefield observation group organized by the North China Area Army on the road west of Hanluecun, Hongtong, Shanxi. More than 120 officers, including a major-general brigade commander, were killed and 13 vehicles destroyed. The action disrupted Japanese “mopping-up” plans for the Taiyue base area.

Casualty figures and unit details vary slightly between accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 日军进攻常德，中国守军坚守多日后突围，中国军队随后反攻收复常德。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Changde; the Chinese garrison held out for days before breaking out, and Chinese troops counterattacked to recover the city.

description.zh:
1943 年 11 月，日军第十一军向常德地区发起进攻，企图牵制中国军队并夺取洞庭湖周边粮区。中国第 74 军第 57 师坚守常德城，与日军激战多日，伤亡惨重后突围。中国军队外围部队随即反攻，12 月收复常德。此役战斗激烈，双方均有重大伤亡。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In November 1943, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Changde area, seeking to pin down Chinese forces and seize the rice-producing region around Dongting Lake. The 57th Division of the Chinese 74th Army defended Changde in bitter fighting for many days before breaking out with heavy losses. Chinese forces on the periphery counterattacked and recovered the city in December. Both sides suffered major casualties.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

In November 1943 the 57th Division of the 74th Army under Yu Chengwan defended Changde for more than ten days of heavy fighting; the main force of the 74th Army operated on the outskirts. Chinese forces recovered Changde in December.

description.en: On 2 November 1943 the Japanese 11th Army moved south from the Gong’an–Shishou area, opening the Changde battle; the city fell on 3 December but the Chinese counter-attacked and the Japanese withdrew in late December.

summary.zh: 中美英三国领导人举行开罗会议，发表《开罗宣言》，明确战后归还中国领土。
summary.en: Leaders of China, the United States, and Britain met in Cairo and issued the Cairo Declaration, affirming the return of Chinese territories after the war.

description.zh:
1943 年 11 月 22 日至 26 日，蒋介石、罗斯福、丘吉尔在开罗举行会议，讨论对日作战与战后安排。会议发表的《开罗宣言》明确表示，日本所窃取于中国的领土，如东北、台湾、澎湖列岛等，应归还中国。

本事件为外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
From 22 to 26 November 1943, Chiang Kai-shek, Franklin D. Roosevelt, and Winston Churchill met in Cairo to discuss the war against Japan and postwar arrangements. The Cairo Declaration stated that territories Japan had seized from China, including the Northeast, Taiwan, and the Penghu Islands, should be returned to China.

This is a diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.zh: 新四军在车桥歼灭日伪军，扩大苏中根据地。
summary.en: The New Fourth Army destroyed Japanese and puppet forces at Cheqiao, expanding the Central Jiangsu base area.

description.zh:
1944 年 3 月 5 日，新四军第一师在江苏淮安车桥地区歼灭日伪军，扩大苏中抗日根据地。日期与战果为通行说法，待页码级核对。

本事件为战役点，不绘行军路线：车桥战役由新四军第一师在苏中发起，与军部驻地盐城不是同一条路线。
description.en:
On March 5, 1944, the New Fourth Army’s 1st Division destroyed Japanese and puppet forces at Cheqiao, Huai’an, Jiangsu, expanding the Central Jiangsu anti-Japanese base area. Dates and results follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

This is a battle point with no march route: the Battle of Cheqiao was fought by the N4A 1st Division from Central Jiangsu, not by the headquarters at Yancheng.

sources.author: 军事科学院军事历史研究部

summary.zh: 日军发动豫湘桂战役，沿平汉、湘桂铁路南犯，中国正面战场遭受重大损失。
summary.en: Japan launched Operation Ichi-Go south along the Beijing–Hankou and Hunan–Guangxi railways, inflicting heavy losses on China’s frontal battlefield.

description.zh:
1944 年 4 月 17 日，日军发动豫湘桂战役，先后在河南、湖南、广西等地进攻。中国军队虽顽强抵抗，但郑州、长沙、衡阳、桂林、柳州、南宁等地相继失守，正面战场遭受抗战后期最严重的挫折之一。

本事件日期与范围取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 17 April 1944, Japan launched Operation Ichi-Go, attacking across Henan, Hunan, and Guangxi. Despite stubborn Chinese resistance, Zhengzhou, Changsha, Hengyang, Guilin, Liuzhou, and Nanning fell in succession, one of the most serious setbacks for China’s frontal battlefield in the later war years.

Dates and extent follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: 1st War Zone troops resisted the Japanese in central Henan; Zhengzhou, Xuchang, and Luoyang fell in succession.

description.zh:
1944 年 4 月，日军发动豫中作战。第1战区司令长官蒋鼎文、副司令长官汤恩伯所部在郑州、许昌、洛阳一线抵抗，因指挥失误与兵力分散而节节失利。第36集团军总司令李家钰在撤退中殉国。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In April 1944 the Japanese launched the Central Henan operation. Troops of the 1st War Zone under Jiang Dingwen and Tang Enbo resisted along the Zhengzhou–Xuchang–Luoyang line but were defeated in detail because of command failures and dispersed forces. General Li Jiayu, commander of the 36th Group Army, was killed during the retreat.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: In the Central Henan campaign the 15th Army defended Luoyang against the Japanese 12th Army; the city fell on 25 May.

description.zh:
1944 年 5 月豫中会战中，第15军（军长武庭麟）守洛阳，依托城防工事与日军第12军等部激战十余日。5 月 25 日洛阳失守，守军突围。

description.en:
In the Central Henan campaign of May 1944 the 15th Army under Wu Tinglin defended Luoyang, fighting the Japanese 12th Army and other units for more than ten days from the city’s fortifications. Luoyang fell on 25 May and the defenders broke out.

Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 中国远征军强渡怒江，反攻腾冲、龙陵、松山，至 1945 年初收复滇西。
summary.en: The Chinese Expeditionary Force crossed the Salween and counterattacked toward Tengchong, Longling, and Songshan, recovering western Yunnan by early 1945.

description.zh:
1944 年 5 月，中国远征军强渡怒江，向腾冲、龙陵、松山等地日军发起反攻。中国军队与盟军协同，经过松山、腾冲、龙陵等激战，至 1945 年 1 月收复畹町，打通中印公路。此役是抗战后期中国军队在滇西的重要反攻，与缅北反攻相互配合。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In May 1944, the Chinese Expeditionary Force crossed the Salween and launched a counteroffensive against Japanese forces at Tengchong, Longling, Songshan, and other points. Working with Allied forces, Chinese troops fought fierce battles at Songshan, Tengchong, and Longling, recovered Wanding in January 1945, and opened the Ledo Road. The campaign was an important Chinese counteroffensive in western Yunnan in the later war years, coordinated with the northern Burma offensive.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.zh: 中国远征军围攻松山日军据点，经苦战收复松山，打通滇缅公路关键节点。
summary.en: The Chinese Expeditionary Force captured the Japanese stronghold at Songshan after bitter fighting, opening a key point on the Burma Road.

description.zh:
1944 年 6 月至 9 月，中国远征军对云南龙陵松山日军据点发起进攻。日军依托坚固工事顽抗，中国军队付出重大伤亡，最终于 9 月 7 日收复松山，为滇西反攻和滇缅公路恢复通车创造条件。

本事件日期、地点与战果待史料校订。
description.en:
From June to September 1944, the Chinese Expeditionary Force attacked the Japanese stronghold at Songshan in Longling, Yunnan. Japanese troops resisted from fortified positions, and Chinese forces suffered heavy casualties before recapturing Songshan on 7 September, facilitating the western Yunnan counteroffensive and the reopening of the Burma Road.

Dates, location, and assessments await historical review.

summary.zh: 长衡会战中，第4军守长沙，与日军第11军激战，长沙于 6 月 19 日失守。
summary.en: In the Changsha–Hengyang campaign the 4th Army defended Changsha against the Japanese 11th Army; the city fell on 19 June.

description.zh:
1944 年 6 月，日军第11军进攻长沙。第4军（军长张德能）在长沙城郊抵抗，因指挥与部署失误，长沙于 6 月 19 日失守，第4军突围。此后日军继续南下进攻衡阳。

日期与主官为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
In June 1944 the Japanese 11th Army attacked Changsha. The 4th Army under Zhang Deneng resisted around the city but, hampered by command and deployment failures, lost Changsha on 19 June and broke out. The Japanese then continued south toward Hengyang.

Dates and appointments follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 中国第 10 军坚守衡阳 47 天，重创日军，最终衡阳失守。
summary.en: The Chinese 10th Army held Hengyang for 47 days, inflicting heavy losses on Japanese forces before the city fell.

description.zh:
1944 年 6 月，日军在豫湘桂战役中进攻衡阳。中国第 10 军约一万七千人坚守衡阳，面对优势日军的围攻，苦战 47 天，伤亡惨重，弹尽援绝，衡阳于 8 月 8 日失守。此役迟滞了日军南进，是抗战后期著名的城市防御战。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为城防示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In June 1944, Japanese forces attacked Hengyang during Operation Ichi-Go. The Chinese 10th Army, about 17,000 strong, defended the city against a numerically superior Japanese siege for 47 days. With heavy casualties, ammunition exhausted, and no relief in sight, Hengyang fell on 8 August. The defense delayed the Japanese advance south and became one of the best-known urban defense battles of the later war years.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a sketch of the city defense and awaits historical review.

name.zh: 八路军南下支队挺进湘粤
name.en: The Southward Column Marches toward Hunan and Guangdong

summary.zh: 第359旅主力组成南下支队，从延安出发挺进湘粤敌后。
summary.en: The main force of the 359th Brigade formed the Southward Column and set out from Yan’an for the Japanese rear in Hunan and Guangdong.

description.zh:
1944 年 11 月 9 日，八路军第359旅主力 4000 余人组成南下支队，在司令员王震、政治委员王首道率领下从延安出发，经晋绥、太岳、豫西、鄂豫边，于 1945 年挺进湘鄂赣边和粤北，开辟敌后根据地。这是八路军在抗战后期的一次远程战略行动。

行军路线与日期为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
On 9 November 1944 the main force of the 359th Brigade, more than 4,000 strong, formed the Southward Column under commander Wang Zhen and political commissar Wang Shoudao and set out from Yan’an. Passing through the Jin-Sui, Taiyue, western Henan, and Hubei-Henan border areas, it reached the Hunan-Hubei-Jiangxi border and northern Guangdong in 1945 to open base areas behind Japanese lines. It was a long-range strategic operation of the late war.

Route and dates follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.en: Japanese forces captured Nanning during Operation Ichi-Go, temporarily achieving their aim of opening a continental transport route.

description.zh:
1944 年 11 月，日军在豫湘桂战役中继续南犯，11 月 24 日占领南宁。日军企图打通从华北到印度支那的大陆交通线，但战线过长、兵力分散，难以长期巩固。

description.en:
In November 1944, Japanese forces continued south during Operation Ichi-Go and captured Nanning on 24 November. Japan sought to open a continental transport route from North China to Indochina, but overextended lines and dispersed forces made it difficult to hold.

This event marks a route segment endpoint; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

description.en:
In spring 1945 the 18th Army assembled at Yuanling and Chenxi in western Hunan as the 4th Front Army’s mobile corps. When the Western Hunan campaign began in April, it stood ready to reinforce the Xuefeng Mountains sector.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 盟军与中国驻印军收复曼德勒，缅北反攻取得重要进展。
summary.en: Allied and Chinese forces recaptured Mandalay, a major advance in the northern Burma counteroffensive.

description.zh:
1945 年 3 月，盟军与中国驻印军在缅北反攻中推进至曼德勒地区，并于 3 月 20 日收复曼德勒。此后盟军继续南下，缅甸战局趋于明朗。

本事件为路线分段端点，日期与作战归属表述待史料校订。
description.en:
In March 1945, Allied and Chinese forces in the northern Burma counteroffensive reached the Mandalay area and recaptured the city on 20 March. Allied forces continued southward, and the situation in Burma became increasingly clear.

This event marks a route segment endpoint; dates and unit attributions await historical review.

summary.zh: 日军进攻湘西芷江机场，中国军队反击，取得湘西会战胜利。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked the Zhijiang airfield in western Hunan; Chinese troops counterattacked and won the Battle of West Hunan.

description.zh:
1945 年 4 月，日军发动湘西会战，企图破坏芷江空军基地。中国军队依托雪峰山地形顽强抵抗并反击，至 6 月收复失地，日军伤亡惨重。此役是抗战后期正面战场的一次重要胜利，也是日本投降前中国军队的最后一次大规模攻势防御作战。

本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。
description.en:
In April 1945, Japanese forces launched the Battle of West Hunan in an attempt to destroy the Zhijiang air base. Chinese troops used the terrain of the Xuefeng Mountains to resist stubbornly and counterattack, recovering the lost ground by June and inflicting heavy casualties on the Japanese. It was an important victory on China’s frontal battlefield in the final year of the war and one of the Chinese army’s last large-scale defensive-offensive operations before Japan’s surrender.

Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.en: The Japanese moved from Shaoyang and Dong’an against the Zhijiang airfield.

description.zh: 1945 年 4 月 9 日日军第 20 军自邵阳、东安出动，进攻芷江机场，湘西会战爆发；中国军队在雪峰山一线阻击并反攻，6 月日军退回原防。邵阳自 1944 年 9 月即为日军占领。
description.en: On 9 April 1945 the Japanese 20th Army moved from Shaoyang and Dong’an against the Zhijiang airfield, opening the western Hunan battle; the Chinese army held and counter-attacked along the Xuefeng mountains, and the Japanese withdrew in June. Shaoyang had been occupied since September 1944.

1945 年 4 月湘西会战爆发后，第18军在沅陵、辰溪集结，作为第4方面军机动兵团，随时准备增援雪峰山方向。

日期与部署为通行说法，待页码级核对。
description.en:
After the Western Hunan campaign began in April 1945, the 18th Army assembled at Yuanling and Chenxi as the 4th Front Army’s mobile corps, ready to reinforce the Xuefeng Mountains sector.

Dates and deployment follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 中国军队在广西发起反攻，先后收复桂林、柳州、南宁等地。
summary.en: Chinese forces counterattacked in Guangxi, recovering Guilin, Liuzhou, and Nanning.

description.zh:
1945 年 5 月，第4战区部队在桂北发起反攻，先后收复柳州、桂林，将日军逐出广西。此役与湘西会战、滇西反攻同为抗战末期中国军队的局部反攻。

路线为示意简化，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In May 1945 4th War Zone troops launched a counteroffensive in northern Guangxi, recovering Liuzhou and Guilin and driving the Japanese out of the province. Together with the Western Hunan campaign and the western Yunnan counteroffensive, it was one of the limited Chinese counteroffensives at the end of the war.

Illustrative simplified route; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: The New 6th Army was airlifted from Yunnan to Zhijiang as the general reserve for the Western Hunan campaign.

description.zh:
1945 年 5 月，新6军（廖耀湘部）近三万人自云南昆明空运湖南芷江，担任湘西会战总预备队并担负芷江机场守备。此时战局已趋稳定，新6军未及全面参战。

空运航线为示意直线，非地面行军；日期取通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
In May 1945 nearly 30,000 troops of the New 6th Army under Liao Yaoxiang were airlifted from Kunming, Yunnan, to Zhijiang, Hunan, as the general reserve for the Western Hunan campaign and to guard Zhijiang airfield. By then the situation had stabilized and the army did not enter combat in full.

Shown as a schematic air bridge, not a ground march; dates follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.zh: 美国在广岛投下原子弹，加速了日本投降的进程。
summary.en: The United States dropped an atomic bomb on Hiroshima, accelerating Japan’s surrender.

description.zh:
1945 年 8 月 6 日，美国在日本广岛投下原子弹，造成大量人员伤亡。8 月 9 日，美国又在长崎投下原子弹。核打击与苏联出兵东北共同加速了日本投降。

本事件为国际事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
On 6 August 1945, the United States dropped an atomic bomb on Hiroshima, causing massive casualties. On 9 August, another bomb was dropped on Nagasaki. The nuclear strikes, together with the Soviet entry into the war in the Northeast, accelerated Japan’s surrender.

This is an international event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.
