name.zh: 苏联对日宣战与出兵东北
name.en: Soviet Declaration of War on Japan and Invasion of the Northeast

summary.zh: 苏联对日宣战并出兵中国东北，关东军迅速崩溃。
summary.en: The Soviet Union declared war on Japan and invaded Northeast China, rapidly collapsing the Kwantung Army.

description.zh:
1945 年 8 月 8 日（莫斯科时间），苏联对日宣战；8 月 9 日，苏军从东、北、西三个方向进入中国东北和朝鲜北部，进攻日本关东军。关东军在短时间内瓦解，日本投降进程明显加快。

本事件为国际事件，不绘制路线；日期按中国通行的 8 月 9 日标注，地点取东北方向示意点，待史料校订。
description.en:
The Soviet Union declared war on Japan on 8 August 1945 (Moscow time); on 9 August, Soviet forces entered Northeast China and northern Korea from the east, north, and west, attacking the Japanese Kwantung Army. The Kwantung Army collapsed quickly, significantly accelerating Japan’s surrender.

This is an international event with no route drawn; the date follows the conventional Chinese usage of 9 August, and the location is an illustrative point in the Northeast pending historical review.

name.en: Mao Zedong Issues “The Last Battle against the Japanese”

aliases.en: The Last Battle against the Japanese

summary.zh: 毛泽东发表声明，号召全国规模反攻。
summary.en: Mao Zedong issued a statement calling for a nationwide counter-offensive.

description.zh:
1945 年 8 月 9 日，毛泽东在延安发表《对日寇的最后一战》声明，指出对日战争已处在最后阶段，号召中国人民的一切抗日力量举行全国规模的反攻，八路军、新四军及其他人民军队应在一切可能条件下，对不愿投降的侵略者及其走狗实行广泛进攻。

声明文本以《毛泽东选集》第三卷所收版本为准。
description.en:
On 9 August 1945 Mao Zedong issued the statement “The Last Battle against the Japanese” in Yan’an, declaring that the war against Japan had entered its final stage and calling on all Chinese anti-Japanese forces to launch a nationwide counter-offensive. The Eighth Route Army, New Fourth Army, and other people’s forces were to attack widely wherever the invaders and their collaborators refused to surrender.

The text follows the version collected in Selected Works of Mao Zedong, vol. 3.

sources.title: 《伟大胜利——中国受降档案》第七集
sources.author: 中央档案馆

name.en: The Eighth Route Army Launches the General Counter-Offensive

summary.zh: 朱德连续发布七道反攻命令，八路军向华北日伪军全面进攻。
summary.en: Zhu De issued seven counter-offensive orders; the Eighth Route Army attacked Japanese and puppet forces across North China.

description.zh:
1945 年 8 月 10 日至 11 日，八路军总司令朱德以延安总部名义连续发布七道反攻命令，要求各解放区抗日武装向附近城镇、交通要道的日伪军送出通牒，限期缴械，对拒绝投降者坚决消灭；同时命令晋绥、晋察冀、山东和冀热辽部队向东北及华北各城市推进。各解放区部队随即展开全面反攻，至 9 月 2 日共解放县以上城市 150 座。

命令序号与时间以中央档案馆藏件为准，战果统计为通行说法。
description.en:
From 10 to 11 August 1945 Zhu De, commander-in-chief of the Eighth Route Army, issued seven counter-offensive orders in the name of the Yan’an headquarters. Anti-Japanese forces in the liberated areas were to send ultimatums to Japanese and puppet troops in nearby towns and along transport routes, demand surrender within a set time, and destroy those who refused. Forces in the Jin-Sui, Jin-Cha-Ji, Shandong, and Ji-Re-Liao areas were ordered to advance toward cities in North China and the Northeast. The liberated areas then launched a general counter-offensive; by 2 September they had liberated 150 county-level towns and cities.

Order numbers and times follow the documents held by the Central Archives; the tally of liberated cities follows conventional accounts.

summary.zh: 日本天皇广播《终战诏书》，宣布接受《波茨坦公告》，中国抗日战争取得胜利。
summary.en: The Japanese emperor broadcast the rescript accepting the Potsdam Declaration, bringing victory in China’s war of resistance.

description.zh:
1945 年 8 月 15 日，日本天皇裕仁通过广播发布《终战诏书》，宣布接受中美英苏四国发表的《波茨坦公告》，实际上宣布无条件投降。中国各地举行庆祝活动，抗日战争取得胜利。

本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
On 15 August 1945, Emperor Hirohito broadcast the Imperial Rescript on the Termination of the War, accepting the Potsdam Declaration issued by China, the United States, Britain, and the Soviet Union—in effect announcing unconditional surrender. Celebrations took place across China, marking victory in the war of resistance.

This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

name.en: Signing of the Japanese Instrument of Surrender

place.zh: 日本东京湾美国“密苏里”号战列舰

summary.zh: 日本代表在东京湾签署投降书，第二次世界大战正式结束。
summary.en: Japanese representatives signed the instrument of surrender in Tokyo Bay, formally ending the Second World War.

description.zh:
1945 年 9 月 2 日，日本政府代表在东京湾美国“密苏里”号战列舰上签署投降书，中、美、英、苏等同盟国代表签字接受。至此，中国抗日战争与第二次世界大战正式结束。

本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。
description.en:
On 2 September 1945, Japanese government representatives signed the instrument of surrender aboard the USS Missouri in Tokyo Bay, and representatives of the Allied powers, including China, the United States, Britain, and the Soviet Union, accepted it. China’s war of resistance and the Second World War formally ended.

This is a political event with no route drawn; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

name.en: Surrender Ceremony in the China Theater

summary.zh: 中国战区受降仪式在南京举行，何应钦代表中国接受冈村宁次投降。
summary.en: The surrender ceremony for the China Theater was held in Nanjing, where He Yingqin accepted the surrender of Okamura Yasuji on behalf of China.

description.zh:
1945 年 9 月 9 日，中国战区受降仪式在南京中央军校大礼堂举行。中国陆军总司令何应钦代表中国战区最高统帅接受日本驻华派遣军总司令冈村宁次投降，在华日军向中国缴械。

政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。
description.en:
On 9 September 1945 the surrender ceremony for the China Theater was held in the auditorium of the Central Military Academy in Nanjing. He Yingqin, commander-in-chief of the Chinese Army, accepted the surrender of Okamura Yasuji, commander of the Japanese forces in China, on behalf of the supreme command of the China Theater, and Japanese troops in China laid down their arms.

A political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.
